articles.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
articles.content: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.

articles.title_zh: 后置匹配抖动
articles.content_zh: 分泌蒸馏通过将事先训练好的教师迭代采样过程压缩到少数网络评价中来加速图像和视频生成. 基于分配的方法通过将学生的产出分配与教师的匹配来实现这一点. 这种匹配往往由反向-KL目标驱动,其模式偏好偏爱主力教师模式,牺牲了各样本的多样性. 我们引入了后置比对蒸馏(PMD),这是基于分配的蒸馏家族的新成员,将模式覆盖的后置取样与任何步骤的生成结合起来. 在零人口损失时,PMD会在每个训练有素的噪声级别上恢复老师完整的清洁图像后传. 其有条理的学生在没有进一步培训的情况下支持在经过培训的时段网格内的任何阶段抽样预算。 为了了解这些后遗症,PMD将以固定的噪音状态为条件的学生样本的指数重估平均数与相应的教师后遗症方法相匹配。 在高斯腐败下,指数倾斜的后期指代是在一个转动输入时的单一教师评价. 我们证明,匹配倾斜 意味着一个开放的邻里 独具特色 识别完整的后方。 因此,PMD通过一个中等约束的家庭来监督整个有条件的分配,没有任何辅助学生-分数网络。 SDXL和FLUX.2[klein] 4B的实验表明,PMD在两种模型上的4步方法中实现了最佳的FID,同时在快速对调和感知质量的度量标准中保持竞争性或领先性能.

articles.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.

articles.title_zh: RL 扩散变换器的后培训是激活引导
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL)后培训大大提高了扩散变压器的视觉质量、文本渲染和组成精度。 由于渲染所请求的文本或组合多个对象等能力本质上是即时的依赖,一个自然假设是,改进它们需要学习复杂,投入依赖的转换. 为了隔离这些收益中有多少是输入式独立转换解释,我们用一个刻意简单的参数化来探索每个RL调制模型:在冻结基模型的块输出中添加了一组固定的导向器. 在SD3.5-M上,这些矢量的参数比RL调值的LORA(0.29M对18.8M)少65x. 我们适合它们与公共RL调整检查站的速度预测相匹配,目标没有奖励. 虽然每个即时,令牌和采样种子的矢量相同,但是它们回收了6个RL调图图像模型的奖励收益的90.0%-96.3%,两个RL调图视频模型的奖励收益的89.8%和111.9%. 初始化为零,并接受在线RL训练,单向量超过SD3.5-M上基于重量的RL在文本渲染(OCR)和人类偏好(PickScore)上的奖励收益. 因此,不断转变就足够了政策性RL后培训的大部分收益:没有新的依赖投入的转换,它就引导预先培训的生成器向它已经可以计算的东西前进。

articles.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
articles.content: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PlayCraft: 从代理游戏体验设计游戏
articles.content_zh: 最近的AI代理可以生成可玩游戏,但这些游戏并不一定是参与. Mastery是参与的关键来源,然而它的设计需要广泛的人类游戏和调谐. 我们提议PlayCraft,一个自动化的框架,它使用一个基于视觉的代理游戏,并借鉴其详细的游戏经验来修改它们以供掌握. 从初始游戏开始,PlayCraft在游戏和制作之间替换. 在游戏舞台上,玩家代理观看游戏屏幕,使用控件,在保留内存的同时,在重复的剧集中追求游戏目标. 每集之后,报告其进展、结果、决定和思考。 在制作阶段,一个制作人代理人利用这些报告来修改游戏. 它估计玩家的能力,预测不同熟练级别的表现,并将这些预测与目标学习进度进行比较. 它通过给玩家提供有意义的机会,通过更好的决策和执行来改进,从而判断游戏并解决差距. 我们通过三个智能环境与玩家特工进行新鲜运行评估游戏,衡量学习收益和学习坡度. 与最初的游戏相比,PlayCraft在大多数游戏中产生更大的学习收益和更陡峭的学习坡度. 它的绩效也超过了每个情报环境每个度量的宏观平均基线。

articles.title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
articles.content: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

articles.title_zh: One President, Two Dynamics: 重用视频传播变换器进行自我监督的Latent 动作学习
articles.content_zh: 视频揭示了世界是如何变化的,但很少有导致这些变化的行动. 后期行动学习从视觉过渡中恢复了这种监督,但往往主要从零开始学习基本动态。 我们问,经过预先训练的视频生成器是否能够为反向和前向动态提供先导。 我们介绍O$^{2}$LaF, 它基于一个简单的原则: 一个前,两个动态。 我们从同一预训视频DiT中初始化两个模型,并适应它们各自不同的角色:一个向导的过渡编码器,为反向动态提供可学习的动作查询,以及用于前向动态的因果的,有行动条件的视频生成器. O$^{2}$LaF通过一个紧凑的瓶颈来控制信息访问, 并优化两个动态端对端, 透过导航和机器人操纵, O$^{2}$LaF在几弹动作探测中设定了一个新的技术状态, 并使得更强大的零弹动作在视觉背景和表现上进行转移。 除了基因视频前传外,我们进一步扩展我们的框架,以预测V-JEPA2等表现前传,实现竞争性能. 我们的研究结果为潜在行动学习提出了一个更广泛的范式:重新使用经过预先培训的视频模型来发现可转移的行动并预测其后果。

articles.title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
articles.content: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 规模世界:通过共同预测和完善实现高分辨率世界生成
articles.content_zh: 高分辨率生成使视频世界模型能够制作出精细的场景结构和纹理,但直接生成高分辨率视频则会产生大量的计算和内存成本. 我们介绍ScaleWorld这个因果视频模型,它统一了低分辨率世界预测,并在一个共享的骨干范围内完善高分辨率. 通过完善自己的预测,ScaleWorld制作了高分辨率的世界视频,而不需要单独的完善模型. 对于每个视频块,共享主干线首先完成低分辨率预测,然后进行以该预测为条件的一步高分辨率改进. 为了支持高效的流体生成,我们保持了单独的因果状态,具有漫长的低分辨率历史用于预测,以及短暂的高分辨率历史用于完善. 为了解决蒸馏过程中的任务干扰问题,我们将专家优化与能力整合分开,并引入不对称的政策蒸馏(TA-OPD). 这一程序通过各自采样和历史政策下的当地速度匹配,将专业教师的预测和完善行为转移到共同的学生身上。 {极限实验证明,ScaleWorld通过提高计算和内存效率,实现了高质量的世界代.

articles.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
articles.content: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

articles.title_zh: 代理Robo批评 : 了解边境代理人在直接机器人控制方面的能力
articles.content_zh: GPT-6 Astra等前沿多模式语言代理已经表现出强大的能力,可以直接通过没有高层次原始物的低层次数字动作控制机器人. 然而,现有基准只报告各集的成功率,这些成功率既没有显示这些代理人如何成功,也没有显示他们在哪里失败。 在本文中,我们提出了对边界人员在12个操纵基准上进行直接机器人控制的系统行动分析。 我们介绍RoboCritic探员,这是一个基于意图的批评框架,在这个框架里,政策代理人在每项行动的同时陈述了当地的意图,一名批评者根据这一意图评价行动的结果和失败模式。 我们的行动层面分析表明,前沿人员在直接机器人控制方面有希望的能力,包括从局部执行失败中进行闭路回收,在各种场景中进行可靠的语义定位,在没有针对特定任务的调整的情况下进行强烈的零射操纵。 报告也查明了目前存在的局限性,包括与任务有关的实际执行瓶颈,例如把握和调整,以及不同失败模式的复苏不平衡。 最后,我们用400个行动人类附加基准验证我们的批评家,并发布12,844个附加说明动作的数据集,同时发布微调开放源码评论家Muse-Glimer-30B,其故障模式精度从32.58%上升到74.24%,从而能够进行低成本的行动层面分析.

articles.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
articles.content: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 深度 Pro 2: 尖锐和短暂一致的度量衡单体深度
articles.content_zh: 我们提出深度方案2,这是对图像和视频的密集度进行全分辨率估计的方法。 通过分析先前的单倍深度估计方法,我们发现它们通常与时间一致性和边界锐度进行交换:多帧法有利于一致性,单帧法有利于锐度。 为了克服这种权衡,我们训练一个单一的,可伸缩的网络,处理图像和视频,并以原生分辨率预测深度地图. 深度 Pro 2 绘制出精确度、锐度和时间一致的深度图,一次一次比所有这些方面先前的工作表现好。 我们发布了一组模型,这些模型定义了一个新的帕雷托边疆,在度量精确度,锐度,时间一致性和运行时间等方面. 我们在https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-septh-pro-2/上发布代码和权重.

articles.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
articles.content: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 科达-达文西: 重新想象带代码2视频的视频生成
articles.content_zh: Code2Video使用代理授权的3D代理来引导视频生成,从而可以对结构和动态进行明确的控制. 然而,如何建立最佳下游质量的代理和激励机制,以及这一模式的能力和局限性,仍然没有得到充分利用。 通过有控制的实验和盲目的人类评价, 我们研究代用颗粒性, 物理模拟, 和催化。 结果揭示了任务依赖的权衡:粗糙的代理偏好自然运动,而中厚的代理偏好一致性. 物理模拟和代理对齐可进一步促进平均质量。 在这些发现的指引下,我们引入Coda-DaVinci,这是Code2Video生成的任务适应代理框架,在代理制导和直接生成之间进行选择,使模型颗粒性适应每个实体,并与代理制导的提示协调模拟. 其多代理设备通过目视检查和独立审查保存现场资产并指导修理。 实验显示在VTR上遵循的主要指示和R2M上的场景一致性,在直接生成上提高物理可信度,比比较的Code2Video基线更高的视觉现实性. 长视频评价进一步显示,在事件结构和连续互动的一致性方面有所进展,同时揭示了过渡稳定性和遵守现场环境方面的局限性。

articles.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 探究"感性"思想:愿景-语言模型中的选择性接入和全球工作空间
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)融合视觉和文字信息,但其输出并不揭示内部概念表现. 全球工作空间理论(GWT)建议,信息从平行的大脑流程中选择,集成在一个共享的工作空间中,并提供给专门的流程. 我们引入了多式联运概念镜头(MC-Lens),这是一种多式雅各布镜头,用于研究VLM概念处理中的这些功能. 它的视觉编码器和语言解码器透镜将中间态映射到一个由解码器输出词汇定义的共享语义空间,以比较跨模式的概念无障碍性. MC-Lens支持内部概念干预,以审查访问概念在下游计算中的作用. (i) 无障碍和有选择的准入。 多式联运概念信息可在中间国家读取,并根据任务需要有选择地提供。 我们把“读出载体”从一个名称符号扩展到一个符号集,以便更好地捕捉和表达概念信息,并支持反事实实验。 (二) 下游计算的概念。 反事实实验显示,获得的概念信息参与下游的计算和推理. (三)发展跨模式对接和选择性准入. 我们开发了两个J空间度量衡,跟踪跨模式概念对齐的发展比在受控VLM训练中隐藏的状态余弦更清晰. 实验还显示,可靠的选择性访问比概念的可访问性发展得晚. (四) 各种模式的共享职能。 在整个VLM家庭和规模中,我们发现,尽管内部组织存在差异,但概念无障碍性、依赖查询的选择性和跨任务干预效应方面有着共同的模式。 这些结论为研究多式联运人工系统中的GWT以及它如何指导改进跨模式协调提供了一个实验基础。

articles.title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
articles.content: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures system-level safety awareness of advanced image editing systems, containing 5,940 image-instruction pairs, covering safe and unsafe images across 11 risk categories and three edit intents. We then probe the benchmark dataset on four systems, including Gemini, GPT, Qwen API, and Qwen Local. Based on our evaluation, we observe a systematic text-vision safety mismatch: Gemini and GPT refuse 87.1\% and 81.6\% cases containing unsafe-intent editing prompts, while only refusing 24.2\% and 22.4\% cases with both unsafe images and neutral instructions. At the category level, most risks are considered inconsistently by different systems, e.g., GPT allows 70.4\% editing attempts of unsafe political content while Gemini only allows 34.8\%. Notably, sexual content shows the strongest visual sensitivity, likely benefiting from mature NSFW identification works. Our findings highlight the need for safety guardrails that jointly reason over both visual and textual modalities in image editing systems.

articles.title_zh: Blind:如何采用多式联运 图像编辑系统处理不安全输入
articles.content_zh: 多式联运图像生成系统进展迅速,越来越强调内容安全。 然而,其安全机制往往依赖一种单一模式,而且缺乏对视觉内容和文字提示的共同考虑,特别是在指导性图像编辑中,上传的图像本身可能带来风险。 因此,我们引入了EditSafety Bench,这是衡量系统一级对先进图像编辑系统的安全意识的基准,包含5 940个图像指令对,涵盖11个风险类别和3个编辑意图的安全和不安全图像。 然后,我们探测了四个系统的基准数据集,包括双子座、GBT、Quen API和Quen Local。 根据我们的评价,我们观察到一种系统性的文本-视觉安全不匹配:双子座和GPT拒绝87.1++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++ 在类别层面,大多数风险被不同的系统视为不一致,例如GPT允许70.4QQ编辑不安全政治内容的尝试,而双子座只允许34.8QQ. 值得注意的是,性内容显示出最强的视觉敏感性,可能受益于成熟的NSFW识别作品. 我们的调查结果突出表明,需要安全护栏,共同说明图像编辑系统中的视觉和文字模式。

articles.title: Multi-institutional grading of Barrett's esophagus dysplasia without stain normalization using a pathology foundation model and multiple instance learning
articles.content: Barrett's esophagus dysplasia grading suffers substantial inter-observer variability, particularly for low-grade dysplasia, complicating clinical decision-making. We conducted a retrospective multi-institutional diagnostic accuracy study of a foundation model-based deep learning system for dysplasia grading, using 969 H\&E-stained whole slide images from four institutions. Patch-level classifiers trained on expert annotations identified diagnostically relevant regions, followed by attribute-aware multiple instance learning for slide-level classification as non-dysplastic Barrett's esophagus (NDBE), low-grade dysplasia, or high-grade dysplasia. On a held-out test set (n = 130), macro-averaged AUC was 0.96 (95\% CI 0.93--0.98). For binary dysplasia detection, sensitivity was 98\% (80/82) and specificity 81\% (39/48), with a negative likelihood ratio of 0.030 and quadratic-weighted \kap{} of 0.83 against expert consensus. No high-grade dysplasia case was misclassified as NDBE. Performance was consistent across institutions without stain normalization, indicating that stain-robust foundation-model representations may remove the site-specific preprocessing that has constrained prior systems to institution-specific deployment.

articles.title_zh: 利用病理基础模型和多种实例学习,对巴雷特的食道进行多机构分级
articles.content_zh: 巴雷特的食道性血压分级在观测者间发生很大变化,特别是在低级血压中,使临床决策复杂化. 我们利用来自四个机构的969个HQQE覆盖的全幻灯片图像,对基于底模的深层学习系统进行了多机构诊断准确性研究。 接受过专家说明培训的补丁级分类员确定了诊断相关区域,然后是属性意识多例学习,用于滑行级分类,分为非弹性巴雷特食道(NDBE),低级血压,或高级血压. 在停产试验(n=130)中,宏观平均AUC为0.96(95\%CI 0.93-0.98)。 对于二进制的dysplasia检测,灵敏度为98\%(80/82),特异性为81\%(39/48),负概率比为0.030,四重式\kap{}为0.83,与专家协商一致. 没有高等级的dysplasia案件被误称为NDBE. 各机构的业绩始终如一,没有出现污点正常化,这表明污点模糊的基建模型表示方式可能会消除特定地点的预处理方式,这种预处理方式使先前的系统受到特定机构部署的限制。

articles.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
articles.content: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

articles.title_zh: 欧拉:AUDO-d Riven 流星神通
articles.content_zh: 目前由音频驱动的视频传播模型可以合成现实的谈话头视频,但一般需要数十个在多秒视频块上的传播解码步骤,使其不适于语音助理和虚拟异形等流媒体应用,因为低纬度和在线因果生成需要属性. AURA 以滚动 KV 缓存按块生成视频块, 只需要当前块的音频开始生成, 而不是像双向模型那样多秒的音频外观。 它有两种大小:AURA 1.3B流576p视频实时在单一的GPU上播放(20.7fps为16Hz回放速率),使其适合交互式的avatar应用,以及AURA 5B流720p视频在9.7fps. 我们的两阶段蒸馏管道首先使因果学生与老师对齐,通过培训使老师的轨迹与传播步骤较少,以及一个块形的滑动窗口因果关注罩相匹配,然后应用分布匹配抖动(DMD)与落后的模拟来缩小剩余的质量差距. 在标准谈话头基准上,AURA 1.3B运行速度比自己的双向教师快23x,并以较低的分辨率达到与TalkVerse相当的质量,AURA 5B与其TalkVerse老师在720p同时运行速度更快. 为了支持可复制性和对流体化的造型的进一步研究,我们释放了两种模型的重量,以及30K合成视频的数据集及其预算的教师轨迹.

articles.title: Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
articles.content: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. Experiments on synthetic and in vivo two-photon calcium imaging data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic embedding optimization.

articles.title_zh: 钙成像线提取的定时嵌入
articles.content_zh: 可靠地提取钙成像序列中依赖钙的荧光痕迹,需要识别其荧光强度能反映同样细胞内活动的像素. 我们提出一个定时嵌入框架,将视像素荧光追踪到一个低维代表,即时间上一致的来源形成空间上一致的区域。 从模糊-邻线图和光谱初始化开始,我们利用精确的稀疏吸引力和确定性粒子-微粒分解的密集反感相互作用与稀疏的边缘补偿来优化一个类平衡的交叉切入目标,避免了扭曲的负取样. 由此产生的潜在表述在空间上解码为可靠的源支持,用于微量提取,而不事先施加明显的细胞形状。 关于合成和活性双光子钙成像数据的实验表明,对不规则和空间接触源的强力恢复以及高效的确定嵌入优化。

articles.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
articles.content: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

articles.title_zh: Plan4D: 基因计划4D世界
articles.content_zh: 大部分未来预测的世界模型优先考虑生成的视频的节拍质量,但由于缺乏明确的4D模型,只能提供薄弱的物理地面和一段时间内有限的几何一致性. 在本文中,我们引入了plan4d,这是建立基因可规划的4D世界模型的下一个可能里程碑,该模型将预测未来的RGB视频与密集的4D几何,包括深度,摄像头,点云,以及从观测到的场景背景和文字特定动作中流出的场景. 由于配对动作和密集的4D说明的培训数据本来就稀缺,计划4d利用了基础视频生成器和3D重建器的补充前身。 具体来说,我们提出一个模型式的刻板结构,让“深度的任何事3”与“长卡特视频”结合,并用一个辅助的DPT头进行场景流预测。 由此形成的模型使我们能够在动态的3D场景中规划和产生复杂,长视距,精细的动作,同时大幅度提高生成的未来视频的视觉忠实度和几何精度. 对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,plan4d在环境反应的基因化4D模型化方面实现了最先进的性能. 项目网页:https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

articles.title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
articles.content: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.

articles.title_zh: Direct3D-V3:原始Voxel域的Latet-free扩散变形器
articles.content_zh: 原生的3D生成主要围绕潜在扩散,最近的进展集中于更强的变异自编码器(VAE),并日益细化从维塞特和triclanes到结构化的稀疏的Voxel的潜在表示. 尽管它们的建筑差异,这些方法都有一个相同的前提:几何首先被压缩成一个潜伏的空间,然后才由生成器模拟. 我们采用不同的路线,提出Direct3D-V3,一种潜在的无扩散变压器(DIT)框架,将VAE完全丢弃,在原生的Voxel域内运行,在培训和取样期间直接模拟原始的SDF voxel网格. 为了让这种直接的 voxel 配方几何上可靠, 我们引入了一种隐含的多重规范 相对于邻邻的 voxel 来抑制非水密表面, 通过 Marching Cube 将预测的 SDF 网格转换成 meshes , 这样正常的丢失可以直接从它的预测 SDF 来监督模型。 为了改进调制图像与生成几何的对齐,Direct3D-V3还预测了调制图像的相机参数作为辅助任务,鼓励DiT学习从图像观测到3D形状的绘图. 这种潜在的无潜质设计消除了重建瓶颈,将培训置于本土毒物领域的一个目标之下,并产生更丰富的本地细节。 预测的相机和原生的SDF voxel输出进一步使Direct3D-V3扩展至基因重建,其扩散与正常的制导改进相交,以更好地与观测到的观点保持一致,而基因先前完成的未见区域. 项目页:https://dreamtechai.github.io/Direct3D-V3.

articles.title: Visual Attribution Limits and Graded Provenance Auditing in Commercial Video-Generation APIs
articles.content: Commercial video-generation APIs bill by model and tier, while intermediaries could substitute cheaper models, lower tiers, or cached clips. What can a delivered file establish about its origin? We combine measurements of passive attribution and cryptographic provenance into a graded audit. We test attribution probes and zero-shot detectors under re-encoding, downscaling, and frame-rate changes, and survey C2PA and GB 45438 metadata across 19 commercial endpoints. Only authenticated provenance supports accusations: tier contradictions or duplicate signed instances under fresh-generation contracts, excluding retries and idempotent returns. Unverifiable signed-endpoint deliveries trigger original-file demands under pass-through clauses; archive-reuse and delivery-parameter screens support review only. Six-model container and bitstream accuracy falls from 83.9% on raw files to 45.3% after uniform re-encoding, using different feature sets. Subsampling real references from 24 to 3 fps raises pooled D3 AUROC from 0.845 to 0.988. Only BytePlus authenticates tier claims under our pinned policy, including 187/187 audited deliveries across three Seedance tiers; tested remuxing and re-encoding leave processed Seedance files unverifiable. The audit identifies authenticated contradictions in 100/100 raw 720p signed tier-swap cases, with zero observed false flags on the tested honest pools.

articles.title_zh: 商业录像 -- -- 传动API的视觉分配限制和分级验证审计
articles.content_zh: 商业录像制作 API按模型和层次计账单,而中介可以替代更便宜的模型,低层次,或缓存的片段. 送来的文件能确定它的来源吗? 我们把对被动归属和密码来源的测量合并为分级审计。 我们在重新编码、缩小尺度和帧率变化下测试归属探测器和零射线探测器,并在19个商业终点上调查C2PA和GB 45438元数据。 只有经证实的出处才能证明指控:在新一代合同下存在层次矛盾或重复签署的情况,不包括重复和独断专行的回报。 无法核实的签名端点交付触发了通过条款下的原始文件要求;档案-再使用和交付参数屏幕只支持审查. 六型容器和比特流精度从原始文件中的83.9%降至45.3%,统一重编码后使用不同的功能集. 将真实参考的样本从24至3英尺提高集合D3 AUROC从0.845提高到0.988。 只有BytePlus认证了我们所担保的分级索赔,包括3个种子等级的187/187个经审计的交付额;经过测试的重新刷新和重新编码休假处理的种子文件无法核实。 审计查明了100/100原始720p签名的分级洗牌案件中经认证的矛盾之处,在测试的诚实池上没有观察到假旗.

articles.title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
articles.content: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D 通过 Sparse 几何- Guided 注意重建
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward模型在3D重建中非常成功,临时的注意设计将所有视图补丁紧密联系起来. 然而,这种密集的全球关注的成本随着观点数量的增长而四倍增加,使模型无法应用于更大的重建环境. 在本文中,我们提出,从古典结构-从运动角度来说,最密集的注意计算是不必要的:3D结构源于2D中的几何匹配区域. 我们用我们的Sparse几何注意力重建方法,将这一原则引入了基于学习的向前进的重建。 在SGAR中,每个补丁令牌只处理来自其他视图的一小组补丁令牌,由训练有素的轻量级学习密钥选择模块选择,以预测符号的交叉视图3D近似性. 因此,全球密集的关注被效率高得多的几何-相似-引导的稀少关注所取代。 SGAR是一种一般的方法,可以通过微调应用到不同的饲料前进模型中. 在我们的实验中,我们显示,在最先进的密集和稀少方法中,SGAR是最快的,也是最准确的稀少方法. 它在1 000个视点上比密集的注意速度快12次,在现有的稀疏方法失败时,其精确度稳定,并显示出在同一时间预算上重建更完整的几何美图的最佳表现。

articles.title: SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
articles.content: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions. We identify this failure mode in MMDuet2, whose proactive area-under-the-curve (PAUC) reward promotes timely responses but does not price the number of emissions. We show analytically that this makes additional responses weakly penalized or effectively free, systematically encouraging over-emission. We then propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations, using exclusive span--emission matching to price false emissions and missed spans. Under MMDuet2's training recipe, our policy on the visual subset of OmniPro replies 2.5x less often than MMDuet2 while raising timing F1 from 0.259 to 0.396 and content-aware F1 from 0.103 to 0.154; a more conservative variant cuts replies by 82.5% and raises precision from 0.161 to 0.418. On ProactiveVideoQA, the same reward adds replies where the baseline is nearly silent, and PAUC ranks a heavily over-emitting policy second despite near-last F1, because it is insensitive to response count. Our results indicate that proactive assistants should be trained and evaluated with objectives that price emissions.

articles.title_zh: SHUSH: 主动视频助理的排放量-警报奖励设计
articles.content_zh: 主动的视频助理不仅必须决定该说什么,而且还必须决定何时发言. 现有的强化学习目标可以奖励及时、正确的反应,而不考虑反应量,从而鼓励不必要的或重复的排放。 我们在MMDuet2中发现了这种失败模式,其积极的低曲线区域(PAUC)奖励有助于及时作出反应,但并不定价排放量。 我们从分析上表明,这使更多的反应受到微弱的处罚或有效自由,有系统地鼓励过度排放。 然后,我们提议对间隔值说明给予排放意识的F1奖励,采用排他性跨度排放与错误排放和漏掉的跨度价格相匹配。 在MMDuet2的训练食谱下,我们关于OmniPro的视觉子集回复2.5x的策略比MMDuet2的频率要少,同时将时间F1从0.259提高到0.396,内容意识F1从0.103提高到0.154;更保守的变种切答82.5%,精度从0.161提高到0.418. 在 " 积极主动的VideoQA " 上,同样的奖励在基线几乎无动于衷的情况下增加了答复,而PAUC将排放过大的政策排在第二位,尽管接近最后的F1,因为它对反应计数不敏感。 我们的结果表明,应对主动助手进行培训和评价,以达到价格排放的目标。

articles.title: Fixing the Last Mile: Failure-Aware Image Restoration with Region-Specific Guidance
articles.content: Recent advances in image restoration have greatly improved global image fidelity, producing visually plausible results across most regions of an image. Nevertheless, even high-quality restorations often exhibit localized failures, including artifacts in semantically important regions such as faces and text, structural inconsistencies, and texture mismatches. Although these errors typically affect only a small portion of the image, they often dominate the overall perceptual quality of the result. In this work, we propose Failure-Aware Image Restoration (FAIR) to address the "last-mile" problem in image restoration. Rather than applying one uniform generative prior over the whole image, we condition a single-pass restoration model on both where local failures are likely to occur and what corrective guidance each region requires. This region-bound conditioning enables fine-grained and controllable restoration that improves semantic accuracy and stylistic consistency in critical regions while maintaining faithful, high-quality restoration elsewhere. Our method complements existing restoration pipelines by shifting the emphasis from global fidelity to local perceptual acceptability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach resolves common failure cases and improves perceptual quality, bridging the gap between technical accuracy and practical usability.

articles.title_zh: 修复最后一英里: 失败- 预知图像修复与区域特定指导
articles.content_zh: 最近图像修复方面的进展大大提高了全球图像的忠实性,在大多数区域产生了明显可行的图像结果。 尽管如此,即使是高质量的修复也经常出现局部性故障,包括面部和文字,结构不一致,纹理不匹配等具有重要意义的区域的文物. 虽然这些错误通常只影响图像的一小部分,但它们往往支配着结果的整体知觉质量. 在这项工作中,我们提出失败-意识到图像恢复(FAIR),以解决图像恢复中的"最后一英里"问题. 我们不对整个图像采用一个统一的基因,而是在局部可能发生故障的地方和每个区域需要何种纠正指导时,以单一通道恢复模式为条件。 这种有区域限制的调制可以进行精细和可控的修复,提高关键区域的语义准确性和语义一致性,同时在其他地方保持忠实、高质量的修复。 我们的方法补充了现有的恢复管道,把重点从全球忠诚转向地方的认知接受。 广泛的实验表明,拟议的方法解决了常见的故障案例,提高了知觉质量,缩小了技术准确性与实用性之间的差距.

articles.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

articles.title_zh: Mind2 Act World:机器人操纵中身体智能、身体动作和心灵动作的诊断基准
articles.content_zh: 健美的智能旨在让机器人以人类般的适应性和可靠性执行复杂的物理任务,这需要三种互补能力:基于历史的认知推理,精确和及时的物理执行,以及通过环境反馈的推理和执行的构成. 然而,现有的基准要么是在相同的任务范围内评估推理和执行,要么在没有组成的情况下单独评估,因此它们很少揭示失败是来自推理、执行还是组成。 我们引入了Mind2Act World, 由来自五个现实世界应用领域的30个模拟操纵任务的诊断基准. 每个任务有三个难度级别和两个场景设置(Clean and Random),产生180个配置. 任务形成三种观点: 基于过去观察的思维测试决定,法案测试精确和及时的执行,以及Mind2 Act结合了闭路任务中的行动结果指导后来的决定. 比较这三种观点可以发现,一个系统是否缺乏能力,还是未能形成它已经具备的能力。 一种诊断方法进一步将三个代表性系统的失败事件归结为Mind, Act, 或其组成,并在一个剖面卡中总结每个系统. 我们对多式联运代理商、视觉-语言-行动模式(VLA)和世界-行动模式(WAMS)的评价表明,单凭一种观点,能力不会延伸到Mind2Act的任务。 即使最强的药剂在Mind的52.7%和Act的39.0%中都成功,但在Mind2Act的12.0%中也成功。 最强的推动者保留任务状态,但与持续接触挣扎,而端对端政策则执行实践动议,但任务状态很少。 这些调查结果指出,通过环境反馈来形成推理和执行是主要的公开问题。

articles.title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

articles.title_zh: 风险控制 愿景-语言-行动模式的试验-时间适应
articles.content_zh: 检索增强的视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型在不更新模型参数的情况下,通过利用专家演示作为额外背景,使测试时间能够有效适应。 然而,即使检索到的演示与目前的任务相关,志愿军可能无法有效利用检索到的信息,最终导致任务失败. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议使用R2-VLA,这是一个风险可控的检索增强VLA框架,通过满足用户指定的任务成功率要求,在最低限度的专家协助下,实现可靠的测试时间适应。 具体来说,R2-VLA学会了一种不确定性预测器,在检索到的演示中估计VLA预测行动的不确定性,指导何时自主行动或请求专家援助。 我们还采用了任务一级风险控制程序,对不确定性阈值进行校准,以满足用户指定的任务失败风险要求。 此外,R2-VLA继续将专家更正纳入其检索内存,以改进今后的适应工作,同时保留规定的任务级别风险保障。 跨越三个甚高频主干线和四个LIBERO基准套件的实验表明,R2-VLA将平均任务成功率提高了9.2-11.2个百分点,在专家请求较少的情况下实现了预期目标. 这些结果突出表明了将检索演示的效用与任务一级的风险控制联系起来,以便能够成功地进行机器人操纵的有效性。

articles.title: Asuka-FM: A System-Architectural Co-Design Framework for Efficient Text-to-Image Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
articles.content: Frontier text-to-image (T2I) foundation models predominantly rely on multi-billion parameter Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pretrained across massive compute clusters, creating an accessibility barrier for academic laboratories. When training DiTs from scratch on single consumer GPUs (e.g., an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24\,GB VRAM), practitioners encounter three primary bottlenecks: quadratic attention sequence costs, Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation graph breaks induced by variable aspect-ratio bucketing, and an autoencoder throughput wall where frozen Variational Autoencoder (VAE) operations dominate step latency. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Asuka-FM}, an end-to-end system and architectural framework demonstrating that competitive dual-stream DiTs ($\sim$206M parameters) can be pretrained from scratch on a single consumer GPU in $\sim$160 GPU hours for under \$55. Asuka-FM integrates four core designs: (i) an AdaLN-free dual-stream DiT backbone reducing parameter count; (ii) structured sequence sparsification via Sparse-Dense Residual Fusion (SPRINT) to cut attention FLOPs by over 50\%; (iii) continuous aspect-normalized Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) coupled with shifted square crop training, guaranteeing static tensor shapes while unlocking zero-shot virtual camera control; and (iv) a pixel adaptation phase utilizing a lightweight (10M parameter) Patch Detailer Head operating under velocity regression ($v$-prediction). Evaluated on open-domain benchmarks without benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Asuka-FM achieves GenEval 0.588 / DPG 78.96 scores at 256px and GenEval 0.609 / DPG 78.51 scores at 512px, setting a new Pareto-optimal efficiency standard for democratic foundation modeling.

articles.title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
articles.content: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN.

articles.title_zh: HumanCOIN:一个12,500小时的用于Egocentral操纵中的人类意图数据集
articles.content_zh: 第一人称操纵数据集将观测-动作对子视为原子单位,并将动作的生成和执行压缩为政策网络的权重,使得动作背后的意图状态无法观察. 人类运动控制研究显示,意图介于观察与动作之间,并沿意图路径留下可观察到的痕迹,从决定到生效:眼睛在手前到达目标,肌肉负荷在接触前积聚,皮质活动在运动指令之前. 为了记录这种规模的路径,我们介绍了HumanCOIN,一个以人类意图为核心的第一人称操纵数据集:在38个场景课上共12,500小时,并有三层代词. 在输出端,L1关注级(10,000 h)从头带镜头视频中推断出凝视,暴露了操作员的下一个关注对象,并在手动前到达. 中途,L2施加级(2,000 h)记录从臂带表面显示EMG,使负载预期在执行完成前可以读取. 最初,L3识别级(500 h)记录头皮脑电图,提前宣读任务决定和监测。 每一级继承下一级的所有代位. 数据集进一步提供多视图RGB图像,深度地图和点云,6-DoF头和手腕姿势,以及步态动作和对象说明. 受控L3设定额外测量 凝视,手姿和手指动静直接。 与数据集一起发布时钟和校准数据,这样任何读速率都可以重新对齐. 三层覆盖三个站台,从视觉定向到皮质准备,使视觉动作对后的过程在数据集尺度上可供建模. 项目网页:https://flagopen.github.io/HumanCOIN。

articles.title: AdaPixFlow: Learning Continuous-Time 3D Dynamics Across Scenes from Sparse Multi-view Observations
articles.content: Understanding how objects move in dynamic scenes requires recovering their 3D motion from visual observations and predicting their positions at unobserved times. Existing methods either optimize scene-specific velocity fields or impose predefined physical and kinematic assumptions. We instead study learning a continuous-time dynamics operator across scenes, mapping multi-view visual observations to 3D object kinematics. We introduce Adaptive Pixel Flows (\ours{}), which learns this operator from multi-view RGB-D observations without per-scene optimization or predefined motion models. The method fuses observations from all cameras into a shared voxel grid in world coordinates, from which the network predicts a continuous-time velocity field. Because the operator is trained across scenes, it learns motion priors that carry over to unseen scenes. The field can then be integrated from observed states to predict object positions between observations and beyond the observed sequence. On held-out PhysInOne scenes, \ours{} improves F1 over the strongest competing method by 2.5\% for in-between prediction and 15\% for future prediction. Compared with per-scene velocity-field methods, the improvements are 30\% and 85\%, respectively. Applied zero-shot to Spring-Gaus, it improves future-prediction F1 by 12\%.

articles.title: FFGaussType: Feed-Forward Conversion of Glyph and SVG Geometry into Compact Gaussian Assets
articles.content: Immersive 3D content allows text and graphical elements, such as subtitles, annotations, and icons, to be placed inside a scene rather than displayed as flat overlays. Placed this way, they respect occlusion and perspective and take on user-assigned materials and lighting while preserving their original shapes. In Gaussian scenes, however, each new glyph or icon requires its own iterative optimization, which limits scalable content creation. We present FFGaussType, which converts extruded glyph and SVG outlines into Gaussian assets in a single forward pass. A point encoder maps anchors sampled on the known surface to a single feature plane, from which a decoder shared by all assets predicts neural Gaussians carrying surface normals. This separates geometric conversion from material and lighting choices, and the feature plane supports image and video coding for compact delivery. We construct a paired dataset of 27,221 glyph and SVG icon assets with anchors and calibrated normal and silhouette renderings, holding out font families for evaluation. Conversion from prepared anchors takes 9.1 ms per asset, at a fraction of the compute and memory of prior baselines. On unseen font families and test icons, FFGaussType achieves $1.62^\circ$ normal error and $0.985$ silhouette IoU, the best among the compared feed-forward converters, matching the fidelity that per-asset fitting needs thousands of steps to reach. The code and dataset will be released after publication.

articles.title_zh: FFGaussType: Glyph 和 SVG 几何转换成 Contract Gaussian 资产
articles.content_zh: immersive 3D内容允许文本和图形元素,如字幕,说明,和图标被放置在一个场景内,而不是作为平面的覆盖显示. 他们以此方式,尊重隔离和视角,在保留其原始形状的同时,接受用户指定的材料和照明。 然而,在高斯的场景中,每个新的格莱弗或图标都需要自己的迭代优化,这限制了可伸缩的内容创建. 我们介绍FFGaussType,它把挤压的Glyph和SVG的轮廓在一次前传中转换成高斯人的资产. 一个点编码器映射锚在已知表面取样到一个单一的特征平面上,从这个平面上所有资产共享的解码器预测神经高斯人携带表面常态. 这将几何转换与材料和照明选择区分开来,功能平面支持图像和视频编码以进行紧凑的传送. 我们构建了27 221 glyph 和 SVG 图标资产的配对数据集,有锚和校准的正常和硅胶渲染,并保留字体家族进行评价。 从准备的锚地转换,每件资产需要9.1毫秒,为先前基线计算和内存的一小部分。 在不见的字体家庭和测试图标上,FFGaussType实现了1.62美元circ$的正常错误和0.985美元Silhouette IoU,这是比较的feed-forward转换器中最好的,匹配了每个资产配置需要数千步才能达到的忠诚度. 代码和数据集将在发布后发布.

articles.title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
articles.content: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

articles.title_zh: MemFolder:用于高效代理内存管理的结构引导内存折叠
articles.content_zh: 长期剂随着相互作用的展开而积累了大型的外部记忆存储,增加了存储,检索和响应生成的成本. 效率受到两个因素的制约:记录数的增加增加了检索费,而检索时间较长增加了预填计算和解码时间注意费用。 现有方法对记录进行prune或合并,但进行搜索可能会丢弃有用的证据,而合并则可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。 我们引入了MemFolder,一个结构制导的内存折叠框架,它相继降低了记录的计数和上下文长度. 该框架由两个核心部分组成,共享记忆组,使用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表述。 RecordFolder ground 实体提及,逐步选择具有代表性但互为补充的锚,并将语义和实体亲和性与时间链结合,将兼容的记录整合为更少的检索单元. 上下文Folder将这些组中的原始记录编码为紧凑文本,并在关键事实无法找到时使用校验反馈来修改编码. 关于基于文本的三个内存基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多式联运基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot的实验,显示了我们方法的有力性能。 值得注意的是,在Mem0上,RecordFolder保留了三个基于文本的基准的最初平均业绩的99.0%,减少了50%的记录,在保留业绩方面超过了最强的基准1.9个百分点。 结合ContextFolder,现有的记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录,同时保留大部分性能.

articles.title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
articles.content: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

articles.title_zh: Awaken-HI:用全人类-Body人类经验增强人造智能
articles.content_zh: 人造机器人的一个中心目标是让机器人从事人们在家庭和工作场所的日常工作。 现有的以自我为中心的视频数据集涵盖了许多这些活动,但很少提供同步的全身运动数据,用于在规模上学习loco操纵. 我们建造了Awaken-Human, 它将大约5万小时的自我中心立体声视频 与同步的全身人体运动, 并覆盖超过100个技能。 在此基础上,我们还引入了Awaken-HI(Humanoid Intelligence),这是人造Loco-操纵的视觉语言动作模型,通过共同行动专家共同预测人类原始运动和重定向机器人动作. 我们显示,当人类的轨迹直接监督共同行动专家时,机能操纵技能会更有效地从人转移到人类。 根据经验缩放定律,增加人类预训数据可以减少被搁置的机器人动作预测错误,并提高下游真机器人任务的平均成功率。 Awaken-HI经过全公司预训和T800改造后,在8项个人任务中取得了93.75%的平均成功率,在个人和长期评价中都超过了GR00T N1.7和0.5美元。 同样的政策一般适用于机器人训练后未见的物体以及熟悉的物体和目的地的新配对。

articles.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
articles.content: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce \textbf{WeMM-Video}, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WeMM-Video:推进开放源代码的前沿 视频理解
articles.content_zh: 视频理解,特别是随附音频,仍然是多式联运智能中的一项核心挑战。 在本报告中,我们介绍\textbf{WemM-Video},一个由中英双语全方位模式基础模型组成的家族,涵盖2B,4B,9B,35B-A3B等变体. 以联合视听感知和推理为中心,WemM-Video在混合思维范式内统一文字,图像,音频,视频处理,无缝支持非思维指示模式快速,直接回应,以及明确分步推理的思维模式. 通过逐步进行预训和培训后的多阶段培训,对模式进行了约1.2万亿令吉的大规模多式联运培训,其中包括多教师OPD、反重复MRDPO和专家RL。 WeMM-Video通过120多项基准进行了评估,在全方位模式视频理解和推理方面表现优异,同时在一般音频、无声视频、图像和文本任务方面保持高度竞争的能力。 具体来说,在全方位模式视频评价中,我们的旗舰WemM-Video-35B-A3B建立了新的开源状态,在缩小与强双子座-3.0-Flash的差距的同时,大幅超越了Quen3.5-Omni-Flash和Seed2.0-Mini-0428等专有模式,我们的紧凑型WemM-Video-9B超越了更大的开源Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. 我们公开发布WemM-Video家族,以及我们的评估和复制管道,以促进开放源码社区的进一步研究和开发。

articles.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
articles.content: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM-Driven重量空间方案培训远景模型
articles.content_zh: 已经证明,在某些环境下,大型语言模型可以进行重量空间编程,直接修改神经网络的重量. 然而,对这些网络的专门培训如何有助于重量空间编程的成功尚不清楚。 我们提出了远景模型LLM驱动的权重空间编程基准,其中五个LLMs编辑了水鸟号、CIFAR-100、PACS和实体-30的演化网络和视觉变压器。 我们报告超过2 600个这样的编辑过程,每个编辑在被搁置的图像上打分,以获得成功、副作用和丧失准确性。 我们比较标准训练与标签平滑,基于梯度的可编辑训练,以及我们的Edit-Ready训练(ERT),这是一种新颖的方法,它排练了直接的,封闭的重量编辑LLM. 我们显示,在标准网络难以编辑的地方,为编辑准备网络将大大提高LLM编辑的成功率。 ERT还在所有被评价的基线中分别实现了GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5的最高平均分. 我们将发布LLM测试框架 与所有任务,编辑轨迹和分数。 项目网页:https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp

articles.title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TacInno: 教学愿景-语言-行动模式----超越愿景和行动的联系动态
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型最近配备了触觉感知器,以在丰富的接触操纵中感知视觉微妙的接触事件。 然而,添加触觉输入会产生不一致的增益,一些粘着作用的VLA模型很少依赖触觉输入,因为许多触觉变化,如抓刀关闭时的凝胶变形,从视觉观察和被执行的动作中是可预测的. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了TacInno,它隔离了视觉和执行行动无法解释的联系动态,称为触觉创新,并将触觉创新仅仅用作培训目标。 具体来说,以视觉观察和执行动作为条件的TacInno示意器将未来的触觉变化压缩为离散代码,政策TacInno-VLA学习预测代码,在部署时没有为代码添加模块. TacInno-VLA在6项模拟任务中的平均成功率为87.5%,在4项现实世界任务中的平均成功率为70.5%,分别比最强的相对活性基线高出10.7%和9.0%。 缩写研究验证视觉和动作调节,多帧编码,以及辅助代码预测的贡献. 这些结果共同表明触觉创新作为大量接触操纵的监督信号的有效性.

articles.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
articles.content: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ViDecide:向理性和计划逐步传授视频传播模式
articles.content_zh: 目前领先的视频生成模型可以合成高度现实的视频,同时在多步骤推理和规划中仍然经常违反物理和逻辑限制,即使在使用大规模推理数据或现有的传播RL方法进行培训后. 我们把这些失败归因于传统的视频培训模式,它把一个解决方案视为固定长度的剪辑,而不是一连串的决定. 我们提出ViDecide,这是一个以决策为中心的框架,它培训视频传播模型,以因果预测状态过渡,并决定何时停止,并有一个以决策为重点的培训时间表。 我们进一步提出纠正精细调整(CFT),通过将其噪声映射到模型本身成功的延续上来纠正失败的决定,实现稳定的改进,而不进行政策级优化. 纵观抽象游戏,规划任务,以及多步机器人规划的新基准,ViDecide实现了83.8%的平均严格成功率,标准微调远高于23.3%,最强前置方法则远高于67.8%,并概括为更大的谜题和隐形布局. 因此,我们的框架为视频生成模型释放了更大的潜力,使其成为视觉界的可靠理性者和规划者。 项目网页:https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.

articles.title: GateTrace: Where Do Crowd Crossings Go Missing Under Occlusion?
articles.content: At large events, pedestrian tracking supports entrance and passageway counts, but totals hide which crossings were missed. In a stadium study, the system recorded about four in five clearly visible crossings but fewer than one in three mostly obscured crossings. The videos lacked trajectories annotated across frames, so we turned to MOT20, which provides pedestrian trajectories and visibility. We introduce GateTrace to locate missed crossings and assess changes to counting rules. It derives reference crossings from annotations under fixed rules, matches reports by person, direction, time and position, and traces misses through saved boxes and counting decisions. With a shared detector, ByteTrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT recover 38.9-46.7% of low-visibility reference crossings on development sequences, versus 98.1-99.0% at high visibility. The gap recurs on two further sequences under a protocol fixed in advance. Published outputs of MOT20-tuned BASE recover 63-78% at low visibility across both sequence groups. Losses stop at different stages across systems. Across four systems and both groups, 47-79% of low-visibility misses have no nearby output linked to the person or no possible crossing in the saved tracks. Removing later checks from BASE on development sequences leaves most misses unresolved and lowers precision against the fixed reference list from about 96% to 77%. Misses also remain among sampled reference crossings that two human annotators supported after checking the videos. GateTrace shows where crossings are lost and measures the recovery and precision costs of changing later checks. We will release the code and per-crossing records.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Gate Trace: 乌鸦十字路口消失在哪里?
articles.content_zh: 在大型活动时,行人追踪支持入口和通道的清点,但总数掩盖了错过的过境点。 在一项体育场研究中,该系统记录了五个明显可见的过境点中大约四个,但三个大多模糊不清的过境点中不到一个。 影片缺乏横跨框架的图轨, 所以我们转向了MOT20, 它提供了行人图轨和可见度。 我们引进了GateTrace 来定位缺失的过境点 并评估计票规则的变化 它从固定规则的说明、按个人、方向、时间和位置分列的报告以及通过保存的方框和计数决定而丢失的痕迹中调出参考资料。 使用共享探测器,ByteTrack,OC-SORT和BOT-SORT在开发序列上回收38.9%-46.7%的低可见度参考过路量,而高可见度时回收率为98.1-99.0%. 差距在预先确定的协议下再出现两个序列。 MOT20-Tuned BASE的公布产出在两个序列组的低能见度下恢复了63%-78%. 损失在各个系统的不同阶段停止。 在4个系统和两个组中,47%至79%的低能见度缺失与该人没有关联,或无法通过已保存的轨道。 取消BASE对开发序列的后期检查,使大多数问题得不到解决,使固定参考清单的精确度从96%降至77%。 Misses还是两个人类注释员在检查录像后支持的抽样参考过境点之一。 门 追踪显示过境点丢失之处,并衡量改变后期检查的回收和精确成本。 我们将发布代码和每条过境记录。

articles.title: SEEC: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Self-Supervised External-Eye Representation Learning
articles.content: External-eye photography captures clinically relevant periocular anatomy at low acquisition cost, yet no large-scale standardized resource exists for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representations. We introduce a 4.35-million-image Standardized External-Eye Corpus (SEEC) derived from fourteen heterogeneous public face datasets, together with a benchmark for external-eye representation learning. For evaluation, we provide held-out evaluation distributions, landmark-annotated anatomical probe sets, and clinical disease-classification experiments spanning ptosis, thyroid eye disease, and craniofacial syndromes. We evaluate representations at two complementary levels: (a) the representation level, by assessing embedding geometry across multiple data distributions, and (b) the functional level, by assessing anatomical recovery, out-of-distribution anatomical transfer, and disease classification. Our models include ResNet-101 and ViT-B encoders pretrained using InfoNCE, VICReg, and LeJEPA objectives and compared with DINOv2 and MAE. Our results indicate that representation-level and functional-level evaluations are dissociable: broader embedding-space utilization does not consistently correspond to anatomical transfer or disease-classification performance, and no single encoder is universally optimal. Domain-specific external-eye encoders outperform DINOv2 and MAE on cross-dataset anatomical transfer despite being pretrained at substantially smaller scale, while external-eye-pretrained ViT models match or outperform these general-purpose baselines on frozen disease-classification probes. We release benchmark code, evaluation scripts, and preprocessing pipelines to reproduce SEEC at https://monkeygobah.github.io/seec-project/

articles.title_zh: SEEC: 大型数据集和自我监督的外眼代表性学习基准
articles.content_zh: 外眼摄影以低收购成本获取临床上相关的腹膜解剖学,然而并没有大规模的标准化资源来评价自我监督的外眼表现. 我们采用了由14个不同的公共脸谱数据集衍生出来的435万个图像标准化的外眼公司(SEEC),以及外眼代表性学习的基准。 对于评价,我们提供被搁置的评价分布、标志性附加说明的解剖探测器、以及临床疾病分类实验,包括硬化、甲状腺眼疾病和颅骨综合征。 我们评价两个互补层次的表述:(a) 表述水平,通过评估多种数据分布的嵌入几何学;(b) 功能水平,通过评估解剖恢复、分配外解剖转移和疾病分类。 我们的模型包括ResNet-101和ViT-B编码器,使用InfoNCE、VICReg和LeJEPA目标进行预训,并与DINOv2和MAE进行比较。 我们的结果表明,代表级别和职能级别评价是分不开的:更广泛的嵌入空间利用与解剖转移或疾病分类性能不一致,没有单一编码器是普遍最佳的。 特定领域外眼编码器在跨数据集解剖转移方面超过了DINOv2和MAE,尽管其预先训练的规模大大小,而外眼前置维T模型则与冷冻疾病分类探测器上的这些通用基线相匹配或超过其绩效。 我们在https://monkeygobah.github.io/seec-project/发布基准代码、评价脚本和预处理管道,以复制SEEC。

articles.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
articles.content: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.

articles.title_zh: 电子控制器 : 走向全面和精致的爱歌中心视频字幕
articles.content_zh: 爱果中心视频字幕需要精细细的细节和准确的时间,然而,目前的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)经常错过简短动作,混淆其顺序,或者误解穿戴者的动作. 现有的标题格式也为将详细叙述与准确的时间相结合提供了有限的支持。 我们介绍EgoCapitioner,它把关于设置、参与者和穿戴者总体活动的视频层面的概述与定时步骤结合起来,这些步骤的叙述适应了不同的概念要求,并在具体的时间戳上标出关键的时刻。 我们开发了一个粗糙到精细的注解管道,在扩展步骤描述之前先建立事件结构,从8个以自我为中心的视频来源获得5万个培训实例. 补充奖励评估事实准确性和涵盖范围,衡量步态时间一致性,并惩罚零散或多余的叙述,指导通过 " 集团相对政策优化 " (GRPO)改进标题。 为了提高事实监督的可靠性,在获得传感器数据时,我们用姿势产生的运动事实补充标题参考。 EgoCaptioner在五个以自我为中心的基准中,在标题质量、标题附带条件的问题回答和时间调整方面,在评价的开源模型中取得了领先的业绩。 它还超过了双子座3.1 Pro on PhysCap Bench,以及所有根据Captal-to-QA协议评价的Minerva-Ego的专有基线. 差异支持事实和时间奖励的互补作用,并表明粗细的注释比单行注释提供了更有效的监督。

articles.title: Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
articles.content: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable. Although Noise2Noise permits self-supervised training from noisy pairs, direct regression tends to oversmooth fine structure. Averaging multiple independently generated samples mitigates this blur, though repeating multi-step diffusion sampling is costly. We introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate this process via few-step sampling. N2N-iMF learns to generate one noisy image conditioned on its paired counterpart; at inference, independent outputs are sampled and averaged to suppress noise. We evaluated image quality and sampling efficiency on simulated thin-slice brain and low-dose abdominal CT across four sampling methods and averaging counts from 1 to 20, and validated the approach on real-world photon-counting CT (PCCT) brain scans. With ten samples per conditioning input and three network evaluations per sample, N2N-iMF achieved a mean absolute error of 2.60 HU on brain CT and 14.02 HU on abdominal CT, outperforming 50-evaluation denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) sampling (2.91 and 14.53 HU). On the same GPU, per-output generation time dropped from 7.29 to 0.43 s. Across eight PCCT cases, N2N-iMF reached a mean gray-white matter contrast-to-noise ratio of 1.341, versus 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM. N2N-iMF accelerates self-supervised generative CT denoising without distillation while keeping the number of averaged outputs adjustable at inference.

articles.title_zh: 快速自我监督 Generative CT 通过少步抽样
articles.content_zh: 低剂量和薄切片计算成像仪(CT)的图像受到高噪声的影响,模糊了解剖细节,而用于监督解密的清洁参考却往往得不到。 虽然Noise2Noise允许由吵吵的对子进行自我监督的训练,但直接回归往往会使精细的结构过于平稳. 利用多个独立生成的样本减轻了这种模糊性,尽管重复多步骤的传播取样费用高昂。 我们采用改进平均流量的噪声(N2N-IMF),通过几步取样加快这一过程。 N2N-IMF学习生成一个以配对对应物为条件的噪音图像;推论,独立输出被采样并平均抑制噪音. 我们评价了模拟薄片脑和低剂量腹部CT的图像质量和采样效率,通过四种取样方法和平均计数从1到20,并验证了现实世界光子计数CT(PCCT)脑扫描方法。 N2N-IMF通过每次调压输入的10个样本和每个样本的3个网络评价,实现了大脑CT的2.60HU和腹部CT的14.02HU的平均绝对误差,超过了50评价的去诺扩散隐性模型(DDIM)取样(2.91和14.53HU). 在同一GPU上,每个输出生成时间从7.29秒降至0.43秒. 在8个PCCT病例中,N2N-iMF的灰白物质对噪声的平均比为1.341,而噪声2Noise为0.916,DDIM为1.176。 N2N-iMF在不蒸馏的情况下加速自我监督的基因CT去诺化,同时保持平均输出数量在推论时可以调整.

articles.title: Contactless Estimation of Respiratory Frequency Using 3D-CNN on Thermal Images
articles.content: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions. Thermal imaging offers a promising contactless alternative to traditional methods, which often rely on partially invasive sensors or obtrusive wearable systems. However, existing approaches for $f_R$ estimation from thermal signals typically require extensive pre-processing and manual or semi-automatic region-of-interest (ROI) tracking, limiting their practical applicability. This study proposes a deep learning-based method for estimating $f_R$ directly from thermal videos, eliminating the need for complex pre-processing and ROI tracking. A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) is developed to operate on raw thermal video data. To address challenges related to small datasets, the model is trained using data augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a validation $R^2$ score of approximately 0.61 on both pre-processed and raw thermal videos. By simplifying the workflow, this method holds promise for enhancing the feasibility of thermal imaging in real-world applications, such as remote healthcare and driver monitoring in automotive applications.

articles.title_zh: 在热成像上使用3D-CNN对呼吸频率进行无接触估计
articles.content_zh: 监测呼吸率(f_R$)等生理参数对诊断和管理各种病理条件至关重要。 热成像为传统方法提供了有希望的无接触替代方法,传统方法往往依赖部分侵入式传感器或可穿透性系统. 然而,目前采用的办法包括: 来自热信号的雷亚尔估计通常需要大量的预处理和人工或半自动利益区追踪,限制其实际适用性。 本研究提出了基于深入学习的估算f_美元的方法. 直接从热视频获得R$,从而不再需要复杂的预处理和ROI跟踪. 开发了一个3D 革命神经网络(3D-CNN),在原始热视频数据上运行. 为应对与小数据集有关的挑战,该模型通过使用数据增强和从合成数据集中学习的转移来进行培训。 实验结果表明,拟议办法在预处理和原始热视频上都取得了约0.61美元的验证结果。 通过简化工作流程,这种方法有望加强实时应用中的热成像的可行性,例如远程保健和汽车应用中的驱动器监测。

articles.title: OffBeat: Multicoset Sampling for 4D Capture Beyond the Camera Frame Rate
articles.content: For 4D reconstruction, a synchronized multi-camera rig records all views at the same timestamps and misses the motion between them. Staggered triggers spread the same frames over more timestamps. However, when the cameras along each row fire one after another, as in 4DSloMo's schedule on the N3DV rig, the row acts as one moving camera that confounds depth with motion. We introduce OffBeat, which models a staggered rig as a spatially distributed multicoset sampler: shifted copies of one sampling grid. From the calibration alone, OffBeat derives camera groups that fire together and their firing order. Since one group records each timestamp, a short-lived primitive can fit an error its cameras share, such as a color offset, and flicker in novel views. We show that a primitive's opacity over time weights all groups equally, for every number of groups, only if it lasts at least one camera frame interval. On Spacetime Gaussians, a minimum lifetime approximates this bound, and a closed-form smoothed box of that length satisfies it exactly, with less flicker than a Gaussian in its place at nearly equal PSNR. In simulated staggered capture on N3DV, OffBeat outperforms the full 4DSloMo pipeline with video diffusion on every test frame, by 3.04 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR. Between the first and last synchronized frame, it outperforms the best synchronized method of each scene, with or without frame interpolation, by 1.98 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR, while synchronized capture is better at its own frames. On PanopticSports, in this frame range, OffBeat is comparable in PSNR to synchronized capture with interpolation. On every N3DV scene, replacing 4DSloMo's schedule with ours raises the dynamic-region PSNR of Spacetime Gaussians, 4DSloMo without diffusion, and our reconstruction. Multi-camera rigs could follow faster motion at the same frame count by changing only when each camera fires.
