articles.title_zh: 关 跳动: 相机帧率以外 4D 捕获的多相机采样
articles.content_zh: 对于4D重建来说,一个同步的多相机钻机记录了在同一时间戳的所有视图,并错过了它们之间的运动. 错开的触发器通过更多的时间戳来传播相同的帧. 然而,当相机 沿着每一行 相机相继开火, 如在4DSlo 摩在N3DV钻机上的排程,该排起到移动相机的作用,使深度与运动相混淆. 我们引入了OffBeat, 它将一个交错的钻机作为空间分布的多套采样器:一个采样网格的转换复制件。 OffBeat从校准中 得到相机组 一起开火和发射命令 由于一个团体每录制一次印记,一个短寿命的原始可以适应其相机共享的错误,如颜色抵消,以及小说视图中的闪烁. 我们显示,一个原始的不透明 随着时间的推移,所有组的重量是相等的, 对于每一个组,只有当它持续至少一个相机帧间隔。 在Spacetime Gaussians上,一个最小的寿命大约就是这个束缚,一个这个长度的封闭式的平滑箱完全满足了它,在几乎等于PSNR的位置上,闪烁的比高斯琴要少。 在N3DV上的模拟错位捕获中,OffBeat超越了完整的4DSlo Mo 管道,每个测试框架都有视频传播,在平均动态区域PSNR中以3.04 dB表示. 在第一个和最后一个同步帧之间,它超越了每个场景的最佳同步方法,无论有无帧插值,在平均动态区域PSNR中比1.98 dB,同时同步捕获在自己的帧中更好. 在PanopticSports上,在这个帧范围内,OffBeat在PSNR中具有可比性,可以与内插同步捕获. 每个 N3DV 场景, 替换 4DSlo 莫与我们的日程提升了空间时段PSNR,4DSlo 没有扩散,没有我们的重建。 多相机钻机可以在同一帧计数上跟随更快的运动,只在每台相机起火时才能改变.

articles.title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

articles.title_zh: 2 Bit KV- Cache 的视频传播变换器在线时间旋转
articles.content_zh: 视频扩散变压器跨解码步骤再利用密钥-值(KV)缓存,这很快成为长视频生成的瓶颈. 我们发现,对时间上遥远的缓存向量进行量化会导致一个大范围且高度的量化错误,但KV-cache中附近的视频符号共享了每个频道的持续模式. 这些模式也因视频的不同而不同,激发了适应每个视频独特缓存的旋转. 我们提议了时间旋转量子化(TRQ),这种方法在量子化之前,在缓存中旋转帧. 对于每一块在时间上相邻的缓存向量,TRQ符合一个正向变换,该变换将块的每个通道表示一个接近跨通道常量的向量. 为了保持量化格式的轻量级,我们把这种旋转参数化为一棵2美元\times 2$ plamar旋转的树,每棵树只存储两个比特,然后是所有区块共享的固定的Hadamard变换. 旋转是合适的,没有梯度 或改变模型的重量, 我们证明一个简单的贪婪的适合 是全球最佳的, 对于我们的“平均膨胀”目标。 每个新视频的变换都是在线的, 我们释放了熔化的Triton内核, 使这个过程在推论上高效。 在2位精度和匹配压缩时,TRQ比最先进的方法QVG提高了V Bench主题的一致性,从LongCat-Video-13B上的90.38到92.02,以及HY-WorldPlay-8B上的86.33到87.61,并改进了其他度量衡.

articles.title: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
articles.content: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.

articles.title_zh: 第一十字: Convex 单波顿 3D 从 Sparse 视图重建
articles.content_zh: 单光子 lidar 记录每个返回光子的到达时间, 使得 3D 重建 从很少的视图和稀缺的光子。 然而,如Tranientangelo等主要神经方法需要超过一个小时的非锥形每层优化,其精度随着光子通量的减少而下降. 我们提出FirstCross,一种无网络的方法,代替解决一个voxel网格上的短序对流问题. 对于一个固体物体来说,带有给定信号和背景速率的射线的普瓦松概率,仅取决于场景通过其第一次穿越,即射线首先进入物体的点. 分解这种可能性会产生两个可拉动术语. 第一类惩罚在检测到的光子前表面,并承认收紧的对流闭合,即用最大流速的体积渲染来代替NERF的产品传播. 第二个是光子,没有表面解释,一旦假定物体在每一个探测到的表面点后面有厚度,就会承认一个对流上方的束缚. 与Transientangelo在自己的真数据协议下相比,FirstCross在每一个测试场景中实现较低的深度误差,视图计数,和通量水平. 与协议的最低通量相比,我们的平均物体深度误差 低于Transientangelo所有光子的一半 根据我们检测到的表面点, 最好的古典聚变 有1.3到1.8倍 我们的三视误差 跨通量水平。 在真实的室量级捕捉 以1%的光子, TransientNERF 有2.8到7.7倍 我们的错误。 FirstCross允许少数查看单光子扫描仪将曝光率削减到1%,并在约一分钟后在一个GPU上重建一个对象.

articles.title: ResVision: Spectrum-Matched Resizing and Context-Preserving Inspection for Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Agentic visual reasoning improves vision-language models by selectively enlarging evidence without adding new scene content, but the benefit depends on whether fine structure remains accessible and whether local observations stay grounded in the full scene. We identify three recurring bottlenecks: high-frequency detail can be attenuated during visual-token formation; spatially distributed evidence can remain encoded yet difficult for the language model to retrieve; and isolated crops can weaken whole-detail correspondence through scale and positional mismatch. ResVision addresses these limitations with two complementary components. Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) estimates image complexity and selects an adaptive global sampling scale, avoiding unnecessary enlargement on simple inputs while allocating more visual tokens to detail-rich images. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each inspected crop together with the complete working view, preserving local detail and global context across tool turns. We evaluate Direct and Agentic variants on four frontier VLMs and 29 benchmarks spanning six visual-reasoning families. Complete ResVision (Agentic Base plus SMR plus CPI) is best for every model, improving by 3.36 to 4.94 points over Direct Base and 1.87 to 2.94 points over Agentic Base. These results show that adaptive visual sampling and context-preserving inspection address distinct, complementary constraints in multimodal reasoning.

articles.title_zh: 反景:光谱-量子调整大小和上下文-为视觉原因进行检查
articles.content_zh: 代理视觉推理通过有选择地扩展证据而不增加新的场景内容来改进视觉语言模型,但好处取决于精细的结构是否仍然可以使用,局部观测是否仍然扎根于整个场景. 我们发现三个反复出现的瓶颈:高频细节在视觉脚趾形成时可以减弱;空间分布的证据仍然可以编码,但语言模型难以检索;孤立的作物可以通过尺度和位置不匹配削弱整个细节的对应性。 《展望》用两个相辅相成的组成部分解决了这些局限性。 Spectrum-Matched Resization(SMR)估计图像复杂度,并选择一个适应性的全球采样尺度,避免在简单输入上不必要的扩展,同时将更多的视觉符号分配给细节丰富的图像. 上下文保存检查(CPI)将每个被检查的作物连同完整的工作视图一起返回,保存本地细节和整个工具转换的全球背景。 我们评估了四个边界甚高频和29个基准的直接和代理变体,涉及六个视理家庭。 完全反射(Agentic Base + SMR + CPI)对每个型号来说都是最好的,比直射基提高3.36至4.94分,比Agentic Base提高1.87至2.94分. 这些结果表明,适应性的视觉取样和上下文保护检查解决了多式联运推理中不同而互补的制约因素。

articles.title: C-LiTE: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Cellular feature learning in Histopathology
articles.content: Characterising individual cells is fundamental to computational pathology, as cellular morphology informs tasks such as tumour grading, mitotic assessment and immune profiling. However, most pathology foundation models are trained on tissue patches and capture cellular features only implicitly, while existing cell-level models are either restricted to specific cell populations or rely on computationally expensive architectures with hundreds of millions of parameters. Applying ViTs directly to small cellular crops also presents an architectural challenge: upsampling increases computational cost without adding morphological information and may introduce interpolation artefacts. To address these limitations, we introduce C-LiTE, a lightweight foundation model for cellular representation learning in H&E-stained histopathology, with only 22 million parameters. C-LiTE employs a native-resolution tokenisation strategy tailored to cellular inputs, processing 64 x 64 px cell-centred crops using a 4 x 4 patch embedding to produce a 16 x 16 token grid without image upsampling. To transfer visual knowledge from large-scale pre-training, we adapt the patch embedding weights of a pre-trained ViT-5-S using a pseudoinverse-based transformation, enabling weight initialisation at the finer patch resolution. We further assemble a pre-training dataset of 60 million cell-centred crops from TCGA, balanced across 19 cancer types and 16 tissue types. To our knowledge, this represents the largest public dataset for self-supervised pre-training on H&E images at the cellular level. We evaluate C-LiTE on seven public datasets spanning mitotic figure recognition, nucleus and cell-type classification, and immune cell phenotyping. Under frozen-feature evaluation, C-LiTE achieves a mean macro-F1 of 0.670, approaching CytoFormer (0.682) with approximately 30x fewer parameters.

articles.title_zh: C-LiTE:轻量级细胞学基础模型
articles.content_zh: 对单个细胞进行定性是计算病理学的根本,因为细胞形态学为肿瘤分级,线粒体评估和免疫特征分析等任务提供了信息. 然而,大多数病理基础模型只接受组织补丁和捕捉细胞特征的培训,而现有的细胞级模型要么局限于特定的细胞群,要么依赖于具有数亿参数的计算昂贵的架构. 应用 直接对小型蜂窝作物的维T也带来了建筑挑战:在不增加形态信息的情况下,取样会增加计算成本,并可能引入插图工艺。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了C-LiTE,一种在H&E有染组织病理学中进行细胞表达学习的轻量级基础模型,只有2200万个参数. C-LiTE采用了适合蜂窝输入的本土分辨率标识策略,使用4×4的补丁嵌入处理64×64 px细胞中心作物,生成16×16的代币网格,不进行图像检测. 为了从大规模预训中传递视觉知识,我们利用伪反向变换,调整了预训VIT-5-S的补丁嵌入权重,使得重量在更细的补丁分辨率上能够初始化. 我们还从TCGA收集了6 000万个以细胞为中心的作物的培训前数据集,在19种癌症类型和16种组织类型之间进行了平衡。 据我们所知,这是在细胞一级自我监督的H&E图像预培训的最大公共数据集。 我们评价C-LiTE的七个公共数据集, 包括线粒体的识别, 核细胞和细胞类型的分类, 以及免疫细胞的麻黄。 在冷冻度评价下,C-LiTE实现0.670的中间宏F1,接近CytoFormer(0.682),参数减少约30x.

articles.title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
articles.content: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png

articles.title_zh: SKILL.PNG:在像素空间学习代理技能
articles.content_zh: 人工智能代理人通常专门从事新的任务和领域,使用技能,即在其上下文中的自然语言说明。 然而,文字技能的离散性质阻碍了持续的优化. 另一方面,精细调整等渐进式方法通常是针对具体模式的,防止不同代理人之间的技能转移。 由于今天许多代理都建立在视觉语言模型(VLM)上,我们可以通过引入Skill.png来解决这些局限性:一种获得技能般的图像输入的方法,其像素通过冷冻VLM的视觉编码器以梯度下降来优化. 图像技能与任何VLM兼容,一个单一的图像可以为一组模型共同优化. 我们显示,Skill.png在16个设置中的9个(跨越4个VLM和4个基准)使用前沿LLMs优化了最先进的文本技能,而只需要64至256个图像符号,而不是推断时大约900至2000个文本符号。 混合技能,即文本和图像技能联合优化,进一步提高代理性能. 此外,一个以VLM组合优化的图像可以成功跨过组合中的模型. Skill.png因此呈现出第一个能够以梯度降级优化的代理技能,同时保留文本技能的转移好处. 我们的代码见:https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png。

articles.title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
articles.content: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BADS-3.0: 实时驾驶感知和从一台相机进行规划
articles.content_zh: 我们问驾驶模型用一台相机和实时延迟能达到多大程度. BADS-3.0是一个1B参数的视频编码器,有四个小头. 从一个前置相机的2秒,它预测了当前的速度,刚驱动的公尺路径,碰撞风险分数和6个候选期货超过6.4秒,在50ms以下. 鉴于该车目前的速度,BADS-3.0在5个轨迹基准上比34B Alpamayo 2 Super低44%的minADE$_6美元,后者读取6台相机,运行速度较100x慢. 所得来自两个模型都没有经过训练的摄像机钻机。 在他们共享的钻机上,两者处于平价状态. 现有基准大多是名义驱动,因此我们增加了两个开放式安全基准,一个是真正的短程相机碰撞和近似失速,另一个是欧洲NCAP方案。 两者,BADS-3.0的通过率都高于我们测试的每个公布的计程员.

articles.title: Tracking Objects Through Assembly and Decomposition
articles.content: Tracking objects through transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. Recent work has extended traditional object tracking to detect state changes. However, existing methods require an initial object prompt and detect only its decompositions, missing assembly events, which begin with multiple objects rather than one. We therefore introduce a prompt-free formulation of this task, where the goal is to recover all object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events given only a video. Our key insight is that assembly is decomposition in reverse. Building on this insight, we present Atlas, a zero-shot system that constructs and jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and their transformations. We further introduce OmniST, a benchmark with dense annotations of objects and both transformation types. On OmniST, Atlas recovers more than twice as many state changes as prior methods while remaining competitive on existing benchmarks that only evaluate decomposition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过组装和分解跟踪对象
articles.content_zh: 通过转化跟踪物体对了解现实世界动态至关重要。 最近的工作将传统的对象跟踪扩展为检测状态变化. 然而,现有的方法需要初始对象即时检测,并只检测其分解,缺失的组装事件,这些组装事件开始于多个对象而不是一个. 因此,我们对这项任务采用了一种迅速免费的提法,其目标是恢复所有物体轨道,并探测只有一段录像的分解和组装事件。 我们的主要见解是,组装正在逆向分解。 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们提出了Atlas系统,这是一个零射线系统,它构建并联合了前向和反向的瞬间分区,以恢复物体轨道及其变换。 我们进一步引入了OmniST,这个基准对物体和两种变换类型都有密集的说明. 在OmniST上,阿特拉斯恢复了比先前方法多一倍多的状态变化,同时仍然对仅评价分解情况的现有基准有竞争力.

articles.title: Digitization of Analogue Gauges using Computer Vision
articles.content: Analogue gauges remain prevalent in manufacturing industries for measuring physical quantities, yet manual monitoring by operators introduces human error and operational inefficiency. This research developed and evaluated an automated gauge reading system using computer vision and deep learning techniques. Three hybrid approaches were implemented and compared: OpenCV with Scikit-Image (traditional computer vision), OpenCV with ResNet18, and OpenCV with VGG19 (deep learning approaches). A comprehensive dataset of 1,848 pressure gauge images (0-10 BAR range) was curated through web scraping, synthetic generation, and augmentation techniques. The experimental results demonstrate that ResNet18 significantly outperforms the alternatives, achieving an accuracy of 97.3%, compared to VGG19's 64.4% and Scikit-Image's 63.8%. The study validates the effectiveness of residual learning architectures for industrial gauge digitization, providing a robust foundation for Industry 5.0 automation applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用计算机视野模拟高日数化
articles.content_zh: 模拟测量在制造业中仍然很普遍,用于测量物理量,但操作者的人工监测却造成人为错误和操作效率低下。 这项研究利用计算机视觉和深层学习技术开发并评价了自动测量阅读系统。 实施了三种混合方法并进行了比较:使用Scikit-Image的OpenCV(传统计算机视觉),使用ResNet18的OpenCV,以及使用VGG19的OpenCV(深层学习方法). 通过网络刮刮、合成生成和增强技术对1,848个压力计图像(0-10BAR范围)的综合数据集进行了整理。 实验结果显示,ResNet18的性能大大超过替代品,达到了97.3%,而VGG19的精度为64.4%,Scikit-Image的精度为63.8%. 该研究验证了工业测量数字化的剩余学习架构的有效性,为工业5.0自动化应用奠定了坚实的基础.

articles.title: Prism: Hierarchical Text Detection with Minimalist Design
articles.content: Hierarchical text detection aims to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs while parsing their structural relationships. It provides essential structural cues for visual text understanding. To maximize accuracy, existing methods typically rely on complex multi-scale feature fusion necks and heavy-weight heads, resulting in bloated architectures and low inference efficiency. In this paper, we argue that a sufficiently pre-trained backbone can effectively replace these sophisticated external modules, while simple geometric inclusion suffices for hierarchical text structural parsing. Thus, we propose Prism, a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection. Prism performs multi-granularity detection by attaching parallel lightweight heads to a single-scale backbone feature map, covering words, text lines, and paragraphs, and reconstructs the structural hierarchy via an efficient geometric inclusion algorithm. In addition, we systematically compare representative lightweight head archetypes and show that pixel-level regression offers the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off in this setting. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that our significantly simplified architecture achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkable efficiency. Specifically, it runs $1.7\times$ faster than LRANet on CTW1500 while achieving higher accuracy, and surpasses the current SOTA method, OmniParser V2, by over 6 PQ points on the hierarchical HierText dataset. Code will be released soon.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 棱镜: 分级文本检测与最小化设计
articles.content_zh: 等级文本检测旨在解析文字,文本行和段落的结构关系的同时将它们本地化. 它为视觉文本的理解提供了必不可少的结构提示。 为了尽量精确,现有方法一般依赖于复杂的多尺度特征聚变颈部和重量级头部,导致结构膨胀,推论效率低. 在本文中,我们争辩说,经过充分训练的骨干可以有效地取代这些精密的外部模块,而简单的几何包含则足以进行等级文字结构解析. 因此,我们提出棱镜,一个分级文本检测的最低限度框架。 棱镜通过将平行的轻量级头部附加在单比例主干特征图上来进行多角度检测,覆盖文字,文字行和段落,并通过高效的几何融合算法重建结构层次. 此外,我们系统比较具有代表性的轻量级头型,并显示像素级回归在这个设定中提供了最佳的精度效率权衡. 对多种公共基准的实验表明,我们显著简化的建筑以显著的效率实现了最先进的(SOTA)性能. 具体地说,它在CTW1500上运行的1.7\times$比LIRNet快,同时实现了更高的精度,并且超过了目前SOTA方法OmniParser V2,在等级的HierText数据集上超过6PQ点. 代码很快就会发布

articles.title: Beyond Covers and Titles: Evidence-First Ranking for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
articles.content: Short-video platforms rank new uploads before anyone has watched them, using content towers that read a video's cover, title and frames. Existing attacks on content-aware recommenders perturb pixels or features and ignore platform re-encoding, and existing defenses train against norm-bounded perturbations that neither match real edits nor preserve recommendation quality. We show with REAP, a realizable attack through {a simulated platform channel (H.264 transcoding, rescaling, cropping and JPEG)}, that packaging edits raise a cold video by 32.0 rank-percentile points in unrelated audiences. We then observe that cold-start ranking does not need the packaging at all: a tower that sees only the video body ranks cold items best. Building on this, we propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR), which scores cold videos from their body, admits packaging only through a support-gated residual bounded by $γ$, and merges cold and warm rankings by rank percentile, yielding an exact certificate against any packaging edit. On MicroLens-100K, EFR cuts the attack gain by 81% and raises cold-start Recall@100 from 0.1133 to 0.170, while keeping the merged NDCG@10 within 4% of the undefended system.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: B. 封面和标题:强势冷锋建议的证据-第一排名
articles.content_zh: 短视频平台在任何人观看之前对新的上传进行排名,使用内容塔阅读视频封面,标题和帧. 现有攻击内容-知觉推荐者扰动像素或特性,忽略了平台重编码,现有防御列车对抗规范约束的扰动,既不匹配真实编辑,也不维护推荐质量. 我们通过 {模拟平台频道(H.264 转码、缩放、裁剪和 JPEG )> 显示, 包装编辑器在不相关的受众中以32.0 级-百分点提升一个冷视频。 然后,我们观察到冷启动排名根本不需要包装:一个只看到视频机身的塔楼将冷却物品排在最佳位置. 在此基础上,我们提出“证据-第一排名”(EFR),该排名从他们身体中评分冷酷视频,只通过以美元为界的辅助残留来接受包装,并以百分位合并冷热排名,得出准确的证明,以抵制任何包装编辑。 在MicroLens-100K上,EFR将攻击增益减少81%,并将冷启动Recall@100从0.113提高到0.170,同时将合并的NDCG@10保持在无防守系统的4%之内.

articles.title: Attention Drift Regularization with Adaptive Initialization for Domain-Robust Visual Recognition
articles.content: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a pretrained source model to unlabeled target domains without source data access, yet two critical failure modes remain unaddressed. First, attention drift: source-learned attention maps shift toward spurious or background features under distribution shift, destabilizing feature representations. Second, domain-gap-agnostic initialization: applying a single fixed source model uniformly across all target domains ignores domain gap severity, causing premature overfitting to noisy pseudo-labels under large shifts. We propose DGA-CAFC to address both failures. The Counterfactual Attention-based Feature Consistency (CAFC) module enforces feature stability by minimizing the discrepancy between representations computed under learned attention and those under counterfactual-inspired normalized perturbations, thereby promoting domain-robust features independent of spurious attention shifts. The Domain-Gap Aware Source Model Selection (DGASS) module estimates domain gap severity via target prediction entropy and selects the source model variant whose confidence level best matches the estimated gap, reducing negative transfer and stabilizing pseudo-label quality. Crucially, CAFC transfers beyond SFDA: applied as a lightweight regularizer to standard domain generalization objectives without target data. Extensive experiments across SFDA and DG benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves over recent baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of the proposed framework. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/DGA_CAFC

articles.title_zh: 注意 漂流规范化 适应性初始化 域- Robust 视觉识别
articles.content_zh: 无源域适应(SFDA)将一个预先训练的源模型用于没有源数据访问的无标签目标域,然而两个关键故障模式仍未得到解决. 第一,注意漂移:在分配转移的情况下,从来源获得注意的地图转向虚假或背景特征,不稳定特征表述。 第二,域-gap-agnostic初始化:在所有目标域统一应用单一的固定源模型忽略了域间隙的严重性,导致在大转弯下过早地过度适应吵闹的伪标签. 我们建议DGA-CAFC解决这两种失败。 基于反事实关注的特性一致性(CAFC)模块通过尽可能缩小根据学到的注意力和受反事实启发的正常扰动所计算的表示值之间的差异来强化稳定性,从而推广独立于虚假的注意力转移的域-robust特性。 域-Gap知源模型选择(DGASS)模块通过目标预测 en来估计域间隙严重性,并选择其信任度最符合估计差距的源模型变量,减少负转移,稳定伪标签质量. 关键是,CAFC传输超越SFDA:作为轻量级常态器应用于标准域通用目标,没有目标数据. 跨SFDA和DG基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比最近的基线不断改进,显示了拟议框架的有效性和普遍性。 项目网页见https://visdomlab.github.io/DGA_CAFC。

articles.title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
articles.content: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MixReact:通过变形器的断裂连续混合从多式Cues中进行基于物理反应的人体控制
articles.content_zh: 日常环境中的人体毒剂预计将像人类一样,对各种提示作出反应,其行为具有明显的适宜性和可执行性。 现有的提示驱动反应生成方法只支持范围狭窄的提示模式,并且仅限于纯粹的动能生成,使得由此产生的反应容易受到物理文物的影响. 为此,我们提出MixReact,这是从文字,音频和视频提示中实现基于物理的反应性人体控制的第一个统一框架,将Discrete-Continentive mixture of Transformers(DisCo-MoT)用于状态预测与具有历史认识的动作变形器(HAT)用于物理执行. DisCo-MOT通过MOT架构内的单向混合物注意,将一个离散的蒙面模型分支与连续的自旋扩散分支对齐. 从离散上下文得到的指导减轻了在一对多反应生成中崩溃为平均行为,而连续状态空间中的直接预测则绕过离散表达的解码瓶颈. HAT随后将预测的下一个状态和观察到的执行历史映射到可执行的动作中,使得在基于物理的模拟中能够进行强力的闭路控制. 跨越所有三种模式的实验表明,在准确性、多样性和物理一致性方面,基线的不断改进,同时证实各组成部分的互补性贡献。 我们的代码将会被公布 以促进未来的研究。 项目页面:https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-09-02.

articles.title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
articles.content: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.

articles.title_zh: SpecWM: 将核查转化为精准的世界流模型
articles.content_zh: 最近,视频世界模型已经先进的交互生成,大型模型提供了更高的质量,较小的模型能够更快的推论. 现有的投机方法通过快速的草稿生成和有选择的目标再生,在解码框上的奖励指导下,将其优点结合起来。 然而,核查只涵盖外部计分员的评价层面,并增加了解码和计分费用. 此外,这些评分不作任何更正,需要为被拒绝的草稿提供昂贵的目标再生。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用光谱世界模型(SpecWM),作为流派世界模型的统一、无培训的推论框架。 它利用目标的潜在速度场验证草稿块。 核查还产生可重复使用的更正;选择两个阈值:接受、完善或拒绝。 具体地说,单步改进可以再利用它来提高知觉质量,而三步改进可以加强相机跟随和轨迹一致性. 这些调查结果促使人们认识到过渡性的改进。 在WBench导航上,SpecWM将视觉质量提升到1.63美元\时速超过目标,并将NavScore从草稿的75.99提高到85.63,实现最佳质量-速度-控制比对. 此外,我们的LongSpec Bench显示出对长期、多回合推出的持续质量和控制,而Hy-Normas的实验验证了SpecWM跨骨干和取消预算。

articles.title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
articles.content: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch. We study this complementary form of transfer through a learn-freeze-transfer protocol, in which the activation is optimized jointly with a source network in a single training run, and is then frozen and reused in target networks trained from scratch. A pointwise activation with globally shared parameters is independent of layer dimensions and can therefore be incorporated into networks of different architectures trained from scratch. We instantiate this protocol with FAct, a five-parameter activation represented by a two-harmonic truncated Fourier series, initialized from a Fourier approximation of GELU and learned in a Vision Transformer (ViT) on ImageNet-1K. When reused in a ViT of the same architecture trained from scratch on ImageNet-1K, the frozen activation (Frozen FAct) improves top-1 accuracy by 1.46 percentage points over GELU. Across four smaller target architectures (standard ViT, Swin Transformer, linear-attention ViT, and MLP-Mixer) and four image-classification datasets, it achieves the highest mean accuracy among eleven activation functions in 15 of 16 settings under a common training configuration, with improvements of up to 1.71 percentage points over the best conventional activation. When the learning rate and weight decay are tuned separately for each activation under the same search budget, Frozen FAct still ranks first in 11 of the 16 settings, second in four, and fourth in one. These results provide empirical evidence that a learned activation function can retain its usefulness when transferred across vision architectures, independently of the weights with which it was learned.

articles.title_zh: 在整个建筑中学习、冻结和转移激活函数
articles.content_zh: 转让学习通常会重新利用一个来源网络通过所学到的权重获得的知识。 我们调查学习的激活功能是否可以转让,在从零开始训练的网络中仍然有用。 我们通过学习-冻结-转移协议来研究这种互补的转移形式,在协议中,激活与源网络在一次训练中共同优化,然后被冻结并在从零开始训练的目标网络中重新使用。 具有全球共享参数的点动是独立于层维的,因此可以纳入从零开始训练的不同架构网络。 我们用FAct来即兴使用这个协议,这个5参数的激活以双调节Fourier系列为代表,从Fourier近似GELU中初始化,在ImageNet-1K上的ViT变形器(ViT)中得知. 当在ImageNet-1K上从零开始训练的同一架构的ViT中重复使用时,冷冻激活(Frozen FAct)比GELU提高了1.46个百分点的最高-1精度. 在四个较小的目标架构(标准ViT,Swin Transformer,线性注意ViT,和MLP-Mixer)和四个图像分类数据集中,它在一个共同的训练配置下在16个设置中的15个设置中实现了11个激活功能中最高平均精度,比最佳常规激活改进了1.71个百分点. 当在相同的搜索预算下对每次激活的学习速度和重量衰减分别进行调制时,Frozen FAct仍然在16个设置中的11个设置中排名第一,4个设置中排名第二,1个设置中排名第四. 这些成果提供了实证证据,证明在跨越视觉结构转移时,无论学习的权重如何,所学到的激活功能都能保持其效用。

articles.title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
articles.content: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

articles.title_zh: 通过适应性数据选择, 学会忠实地思考图像
articles.content_zh: 用图像思考(TwI)可以增强视觉语言模型(VLMs)的能力,通过积极裁剪和放大精细的视觉细节来克服知觉瓶颈,同时保证更高的准确度和可解释的,基于区域的推理. 然而,我们的分析表明,TwI模型精度的提高并不能保证忠实工具的使用;它们经常引用工具而不实际依赖放大区域,破坏了工具辅助推理的可靠性. 我们追踪这种不诚实的行为到训练数据:当问题解答而不缩放时,模型可以正确回答,同时忽略返回的证据,随着模型在没有工具的情况下更善于回答,这个问题在训练期间变得更加严重. 为了在整个培训中保持放大效果,我们根据模型不断发展的能力调整培训数据,并对正确放大的证据仍然能帮助模型正确回答的问题进行培训。 这一选择得到了数据合成管道的支持,该管道将小物体定位,并构建关于其细微细节的可核查问题,并辅以适应性奖励,在不需要缩放时有利于无工具答案. 实验结果显示,我们的方法大大提高了推理的忠诚度,实现了视觉搜索基准(V*+11.6%,HR-Bench 4K+7.9%,HR-Bench 8K+9.4%)的先进性能. 在多式联运幻觉基准方面,我们的模型也超过了比较的TwI基线。 这些结果表明,提高TwI的忠诚度不会牺牲准确性,而且两者都可以从正确的培训数据中学习,而不直接监督推理过程。

articles.title: A version of the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for full/quad pol synthetic aperture radar data
articles.content: Based on the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition of reflection symmetric polarimetric SAR data we present a version for full/quad polarisation data. We demonstrate both versions on X-band F-SAR data over Vejers, Denmark. Differences between the original and our version of the decomposition occur especially for very bright man-made targets. These differences come with lower entropy for our version giving an improved focus on a more pronounced dominant scattering mechanism for these objects. Interpretation of the scattering mechanism related to the full/quad pol version of the decomposition is facilitated by means of the Cloude/Pottier $\barα$ angle.

articles.title_zh: Cloude/van Zyl 完全/quad 合成孔径雷达数据的分解版本
articles.content_zh: 基于Cloude/van Zyl 反射对称极性合成孔径雷达数据的分解,我们提出了全方位极化数据的版本。 我们用X波段F-SAR数据在丹麦的Vejers上演示两个版本. 原版和我们版本的分解特别针对非常明亮的人造目标. 这些差异与我们版本的低等离子体相比,使得人们更加关注这些物体的更显著的散射机制。 通过Cloude/Pottier $\barα$角度,有助于解释与整/整波尔分解版本有关的散射机制。

articles.title: Backbone Matters: Benchmarking Encoder-Decoder Networks for Semantic Segmentation of Driving Scenes on BDD100K
articles.content: Semantic segmentation gives an autonomous vehicle a dense, pixel-level description of its surroundings and is a core part of scene understanding. Most segmentation networks consist of an encoder (the backbone) and a decoder, yet the backbone is often chosen without a systematic comparison. This work studies this choice on the BDD100K driving dataset. Four widely used decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet and PSPNet) are combined with 13 backbones from six families (ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception, MobileNet and EfficientNet), and all 52 models are trained with one common protocol. The best model, an FPN decoder with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone, reaches 62.6% mean intersection over union (mIoU), 89.8% accuracy and a loss of 0.092. Only two of the 52 models, both FPN with EfficientNet, exceed the 56.9% mIoU reported with the BDD100K benchmark. The effect of the backbone depends strongly on the decoder: the same EfficientNet-B4 gives 42.6% mIoU with PSPNet but 62.6% with FPN, and the gap between the best and the worst backbone ranges from 12.0 points (U-Net) to 42.5 points (FPN). The results and the scope of this study are discussed.

articles.title_zh: 背骨问题:为BDD100K上驾驶场的语义分区设定编码器-Decoder网络基准
articles.content_zh: 语义分割给一个自主的飞行器一个密集的,像素级的关于其周围的描述,是场景理解的核心部分. 大多数分块网络由编码器(骨干)和解码器组成,然而骨干却经常在没有系统比较的情况下被选择. 本作研究了BDD100K驱动数据集的这一选择. 4个广泛使用的解码器(U-Net,FPN,LinkNet和PSPNet)与来自6个家庭(ResNet,VGG,DenseNet,Inception,MobileNet和IncelNet)的13个骨干结合,所有52个型号都经过一个共同协议的培训. 最佳型号是一台具有高效Net-B4主干线的FPN解码器,在结合(mIoU)上达到62.6%的正交,准确度89.8%,损失0.092. 在52种模式中,只有2种模式,其中既有 " 高效网络 " 的 " FPN " 模式,都超过了按BDD100K基准报告的56.9%的MIOU。 骨干的作用很大程度上依赖于解码器:同样高效的Net-B4给与PSPNet的mIoU42.6%,而FPN的mIoU62.6%,最佳骨干和最差骨干之间的差距从12.0点(U-Net)到42.5点(FPN)不等. 报告讨论了这项研究的结果和范围。

articles.title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
articles.content:
Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples.
  Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment.
  We benchmark PCF on controlled transports, sample-efficiency studies, and high-dimensional alignment tasks. PCF matches the accuracy of kernel MMD on the controlled benchmark and on raw-pixel MNIST--USPS at a cost linear in the batch size, and it is more sample-efficient, achieving lower endpoint error than MMD in 13 of 15 paired runs across library sizes. By avoiding pairwise kernel evaluation, it reduces discrepancy memory by 29.8% and trains at batch sizes where kernel MMD exceeds GPU memory. These results show that PCF provides accurate and efficient invertible transport, particularly in sample- and memory-limited settings.

articles.title_zh: 通过预测特征函数在样本-唯一分布之间进行不可逆运输
articles.content_zh:
许多有用的潜在分布可取样,但密度不易拉动。 这种分布可能表现为实际世界观测的经验性收集或由科学模拟器和黑盒基因模型生成. 这些只有样本的前科不能直接用于基于概率的常态化流,这需要评价先前的密度. 我们提出预测特征-功能匹配(PCF),这是在数据分布和仅通过样本指定的先前地图之间学习不可逆图的无密度框架.
我们的方法利用预测的经验特征功能来调整分布,从而不再需要密度估计、对抗性训练或对等观测。 为解决运输图的非独特性,我们引入了一种可选的运输规范化器,在保留端点对齐的同时,选择更低位位移转换.
我们以受控运输、样本效率研究以及高维度对齐任务为基准来衡量PCF。 PCF在控制基准和原始像素 MNIST-USPS上以批量大小的成本线性匹配内核MMD的精度,且其样本效率更高,在15对运行的13对中实现了比MMD更低的端点误差. 通过避免双向内核评价,将差异内存减少29.8%,在内核MMD超过GPU内存的批量规模下进行列车. 这些结果显示,PCF提供了准确有效的不可逆运输,特别是在样本和内存有限的环境下.

articles.title: RegionAgent: Two-Stage Preference Optimization for Regional Image Restoration
articles.content: Images under non-uniform coupled degradations require diverse restoration capabilities for different degraded regions. Existing methods employ globally uniform operations, potentially overlooking regional differences and causing incomplete restoration or even damage to image content. Moreover, a degraded region may require successive restoration actions, and earlier actions may alter residual degradation characteristics or introduce artifacts, potentially hindering subsequent restoration. To address these challenges, we propose RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework that trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) through two-stage preference learning to generate a region-specific restoration action at each iteration. Specifically, we first train the VLM to select an action suited to the current region through step-level Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), using preferences derived from immediate restoration feedback to supervise only the differing component in each action pair. To account for the effects of current actions on subsequent restoration, we then apply trajectory-level DPO, using preferences derived from complete trajectory scores to supervise the sole differing action in each trajectory pair. Furthermore, as conventional image-pair datasets do not directly provide preferences over regional restoration decisions, we construct a regional restoration preference dataset comprising 10K action pairs and 20K trajectory pairs for two-stage VLM training. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate strong restoration performance under both mixed and single degradations. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of two-stage preference learning in improving restoration quality.

articles.title_zh: 区域特派员:优化区域图像修复双步骤优先
articles.content_zh: 非统一情况下的图像结合退化需要不同的退化区域具有不同的恢复能力。 现有方法采用全球统一操作,可能忽略区域差异,造成图像内容的修复甚至损害不完整。 此外,退化区域可能需要连续的恢复行动,而早期行动可能改变残余退化特征或引进文物,从而可能妨碍随后的恢复。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议区域代理人,通过两个阶段的偏好学习,培训一个远景-语言模型,在每个周期产生一个针对区域的恢复行动。 具体来说,我们首先通过步骤级直接偏好优化(DPO)来训练VLM来选择适合当前区域的动作,利用从即时恢复反馈中得出的偏好,只监督每个动作配对中不同的组件. 为了说明当前行动对后续恢复的影响,我们然后采用轨迹等级的DPO,利用从完整轨迹分数中得出的偏好来监督每对轨迹中唯一不同的动作. 此外,由于传统的图像-图像数据集并不直接提供优于区域恢复决定的偏好,我们构建了一个区域恢复偏好数据集,由10K对动作和20K对轨迹组成,用于两级VLM培训。 跨越多个数据集的实验表明,在混合降解和单一降解下,恢复性能强劲。 校对研究进一步验证了两阶段优先学习在提高修复质量方面的有效性.

articles.title: FlexVSR: Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution for Streaming Video Generation
articles.content: Real-time streaming video generation has gained rapid momentum in live content creation and interactive media. Deploying such systems in practice requires flexible scaling factors to accommodate diverse source resolutions, target displays, and computational budgets. However, extending fixed-scale generative video super-resolution (VSR) to varying target scales poses two challenges: downsampling from a larger fixed scale incurs redundant cost, while re-optimizing the diffusion transformer (DiT) is costly and alters the shared generative prior. To address both, we propose FlexVSR, a decoupled framework for continuous-scale streaming generative VSR with supervision at only a few scales. Our key insight is that naively resampling fixed-scale latents onto a new target grid induces scale-dependent input mismatch, which can be effectively addressed through parameter-efficient, scale-aware adaptation of the latent interface without updating the DiT. To this end, FlexVSR introduces ReLSA (Refined Latent Scale Adaptation), a lightweight latent adapter that constructs and refines target-grid latents before they enter the DiT, enabling a shared frozen VSR prior to generalize across continuous scales with only 0.274M trainable parameters and an adaptation cost of 7.3 H100 GPU-hours, while introducing no additional temporal dependencies and preserving the native causal streaming protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive or superior reconstruction and temporal quality, lower latency than most native-scale streaming baselines and offline methods, and effective generalization to unseen continuous scales, filling the continuous-scale gap in real-time streaming generative VSR.

articles.title_zh: FlexVSR:流式视频生成的连续超分辨率
articles.content_zh: 实时流媒体制作在现场内容创作和互动媒体方面获得了快速势头. 在实践中部署这种系统需要灵活的比例因素,以适应不同的源分辨率、目标显示和计算预算。 然而,将固定规模的基因视频超分辨率(VSR)扩展至不同目标尺度带来了两个挑战:从较大的固定尺度下取样会产生冗余成本,而重新优化扩散变压器(DiT)则成本高昂,并改变之前共享的基因. 为了解决这两个问题,我们提议采用FlexVSR,这是在少数规模的监督下进行连续流转基因VSR的脱钩框架。 我们的关键见解是,天真地将固定尺度的潜伏物复制到一个新的目标网格上,会导致依赖尺度的输入不匹配,可以通过参数效率高,具有尺度意识的潜伏界面改造而无需更新DiT来有效解决. 为此,FlexVSR引入了ReLSA(Retined Latent Scale Redition),这是一种轻量级潜伏适配器,在进入DiT前构造和精炼目标网潜,使得共享的冷冻VSR在跨连续尺度通用前,只有0.274M的可训练参数和7.3H100GPU小时的适应成本,同时不引入额外的时间依赖性,并保留本土因源流协议. 广泛的实验表明,重建和时间质量具有竞争力或优越性,与大多数本土规模的流线基线和离线方法相比,耐久性较低,而且有效概括到看不见的连续尺度,填补了实时流线基因VSR的连续尺度差距。

articles.title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
articles.content: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.

articles.title_zh: SpaceScout-V2:VLM代理能否积极探索现实世界3D场景并定位对象?.
articles.content_zh: 空间情报要求特工获取视觉证据,将部分观测纳入连贯的三维表达. 我们引入了SpaceScout-V2,通过三个进步将SpaceScout的主动绘图任务从模拟扩展到真实的住宅场景:真实的视觉观测,保存原始场景内容,以及互动探索所记录的视图. 该基准建于Realsee3D的100户人家,涵盖29个类别的3 171个目标物体。 鉴于一个固定的目标清单,代理商会自主选择记录的观点和查看方向,整合校准的RGB观测结果,并在固定的交互预算中反复估计和修改对象中心. 我们使用IoU、IoU阈值命中率和目标覆盖率来评价对象中心地图的本地化准确性和完整性。 对7种前沿视觉语言模型(VLMs)进行评估后,我们发现有6种实现全目标平均IoU低于20\%. 甚至表现最好的模型克劳德·奥普斯5.5也只达到22.52-QQ,只有18.36+X的目标超过了0.5的IoU. 进一步的分析表明,广泛的提交范围可以与有限的本地化准确性并存,而目标遗漏则会进一步降低总体分数. 这些结果突出说明了在通过积极探索真实场景来绘制准确和完整的物体中心地图方面的重大挑战。

articles.title: StreamEgo: Streaming Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
articles.content: Exocentric-to-egocentric (Exo2Ego) video generation transforms third-person recordings into first-person viewpoints, unlocking immersive AR/VR experiences and scalable demonstration synthesis for embodied robotics. Extending it to a streaming setting is expected to further enable live applications. However, existing methods suffer from degraded manipulation regions, overfitting and confinement to fixed-length clips with prohibitive latency. To address these limitations, we present StreamEgo, a real-time framework for unbounded, generalizable Exo2Ego video generation. To resolve intricate manipulation dynamics while supporting the streaming pipeline, a streaming dual-branch prior provides pixel-aligned guidance for translating appearance and skeletal kinematics. We also introduce a region-aware loss curriculum to improve generalization and stabilize multi-objective diffusion training. Furthermore, we distill the model into a chunk-wise autoregressive model, augmented with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum, enabling high-quality, generalizable real-time streaming Exo2Ego generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.

articles.title_zh: StreamEgo:向外偏心流转 视频生成
articles.content_zh: 异心对异心(Exo2Ego)视频生成将第三人称录音转换成第一人称视角,解锁浸润的AR/VR体验和可缩放的演示合成,用于体现的机器人. 将它扩展至流媒体环境,可望进一步实现实时应用。 然而,现有方法因操纵区域退化而受到影响,过于适应,并被固定长度的短片夹住,难以承受。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了StreamEgo,即一个无约束、通用的Exo2Ego视频生成的实时框架。 为了解决复杂的操纵动态,同时支持流线管道,流线双分支前传为外观和骨骼动能的翻译提供了像素对齐的指导. 我们还引入了区域意识损失课程,以改进普及和稳定多目标传播培训。 此外,我们将该模型提炼成一个零星的自动递减模型,并辅之以区域意识的腐败机制和第一流课程,使一个单一的H100GPU上24.3FPS的Exo2Ego一代能够高质量、通用的实时流线。

articles.title: MultiBinder: Preventing Multi-Subject Identity Leakage in Personalized Video Generation
articles.content: Personalized video generation faces a significant scalability challenge: as the number of custom subjects increases, existing methods suffer from severe identity leakage and semantic entanglement, resulting in videos with blended attributes and incoherent narratives. We identify that this stems from a lack of explicit binding between textual entity phrases and their corresponding visual patterns prior to fusion in diffusion models. To address this, we propose MultiBinder, a novel framework built on a ``bind-then-narrate'' paradigm. Our approach introduces a two-stage conditioning process before video diffusion. First, Cross-modal Entity Binding devises an entity-aware Q-Former to extract identity-centric features from each subject's reference image and tightly align them with its unique entity phrase, yielding disentangled ``identity tokens.'' Second, a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) acts as a ``narrative director'' in the Narrative-Aware Subject Arrangement stage, capturing the action of each subject from the text prompt and synthesizes contextualized subject features that encapsulate ``who is doing what'' and preserve role-specific distinctions. These features are then injected into a video diffusion model via dedicated conditioning pathways, ensuring precise attribute allocation. Extensive experiments on both general and newly curated multi-subject benchmarks show that MultiBinder significantly outperforms existing methods in multi-subject identity fidelity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MultiBinder:在个性化视频生成中防止多对象身份泄露
articles.content_zh: 个性化的视频生成面临显著的可扩展性挑战:随着定制题材数量的增加,现有方法受到严重的身份泄露和语义纠缠,导致视频带有混合属性和不连贯的叙事. 我们发现,这是因为文本实体短语及其在扩散模型中聚变之前的相应视觉模式之间缺乏明确的约束。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议“多辛德尔”,一个建立在“当时的叙述”范式基础上的新框架。 我们的方法引入了视频传播前的两阶段调制程序. 首先,跨模式实体绑定设计了一个实体意识的Q-Former,从每个主体的参考图像中提取以身份为中心的特征,并将其与其独特的实体短语紧密地对齐,产生"dentity signments.". 第二,“多式大语文模式”在“叙述式”-“了解”主题安排阶段起“叙述式主任”的作用,将每个主题的行动从文本的提示中抓住来,并综合了“谁在做什么”的背景化主题特征,并保持了特定角色的区别。 这些功能随后通过专用的调节路径注入视频传播模型,确保精确的属性分配. 对一般和新拟定的多主体基准的广泛实验表明,多主体调查在多主体身份忠诚度方面大大超过现有方法。

articles.title: When Foundation Models Disagree: Representational Heterogeneity for Calibrated Uncertainty in Whole-Slide Image Classification
articles.content: Pathology foundation models supply strong representations for whole-slide image classification, yet the confidence attached to their predictions remains hard to trust. Prevailing uncertainty estimators act within a single feature space and thereby overlook the uncertainty that the choice of foundation-model representation itself induces. This work introduces CALIFUSE, a calibration-oriented framework that fuses several pathology foundation models for the specific purpose of uncertainty estimation. Departing from accuracy-driven fusion, CALIFUSE reads representational heterogeneity across encoders as an explicit confidence cue. Slide-level decision consensus is coupled with chunk-level evidence agreement quantified through Jensen-Shannon divergence, so that both prediction stability and fine-grained evidence consistency inform the estimate. Foundation-model encoders stay frozen. A task-specific nnMIL classifier is still trained for each FM; CALIFUSE then estimates confidence at inference without training an extra fusion module. Evaluated on seven WSI classification tasks under several foundation-model combinations, the framework sharpens calibration, misclassification detection, and selective prediction relative to both the strongest single-encoder baseline and naive ensemble averaging, all while preserving competitive balanced accuracy.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当基础模型不一致时:全滑图像分类中校准不确定性的代表性异质性
articles.content_zh: 病理基础模型为全塌方图像分类提供了强烈的表示,然而其预测所附带的信心仍然难以相信. 常见的不确定性估计器在一个单一的特征空间内行事,从而忽略了选择基础模型代表本身引起的不确定性。 这项工作引入了CALIFUSE,这是一个面向校准的框架,为不确定性估计的特定目的,将几种病理基础模型融合在一起。 脱离精度驱动的聚变,CALIFUSE将跨编码器的表征异质性视为一个明确的置信提示. 幻灯片级决策共识与通过Jensen-Shannon差异量化的块级证据协议相结合,从而使预测稳定性和精细证据一致性成为估计数的依据。 基金会模型编码器被冻结了 仍然为每个调频台培训一个任务特定的nnMIL分类器;然后,CALIFUSE在没有培训一个额外的聚变模块的情况下估算推断置信度. 对几个基础模型组合下的7个WSI分类任务进行了评价,框架比最强的单编码器基线和天真综艺平均率更精准,同时保持了竞争性平衡的准确性。

articles.title: A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1
articles.content: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于Unitree GO1的实用可控数据收集工具
articles.content_zh: Unitree Go1是一个广泛使用的用于腿形机器人研究的平台,然而从它收集自制数据却不必要地困难:Unitree SDK的文献资料很少,Go1的原生中件ROS1(Robot操作系统)则被完全贬值. 我们提供了一个开源图形工具,使研究人员能够可靠地记录Go1的自发数据,包括联合状态、IMU(惯性测量单位)读数、脚力传感器数据和陀螺仪测量,而不需要ROS的专门知识。 该工具提供了一个简单的图形用户界面(GUI)(Graphical User Interface),用于实时开始,停止和标签录音. 本文件的贡献是收集工具。 我们描述与它一起收集的51份录音的获取质量,包括达到的取样率和重复样品。 作为二级的,刻意的微调数据有用, 我们训练一个地形分类器在上面。 其结果是微弱的:一个Temperal Curvolutional Network在10个地形等级的被搁置录音上达到约38%的准确度(10%是偶然的),而一个窗口层的分割忽略了记录边界,将同样的测量夸大到约99%. 我们报告这是为了证明记录的信号携带地形信息,而不是作为一个竞争性的分类器. 该用途旨在降低障碍,以收集没有ROS的Go1自主数据。

articles.title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
articles.content: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界模型能否预测稻米增长? 走向农业世界模式
articles.content_zh: 世界模型可以想象一个物理场景在接下来的几秒钟里是如何演变的,但是种植者需要知道一种作物会如何在几周到几个月的时间里发展:这个稻田会从现在开始开花一个月,它如何看待收成? 我们引入了农业世界建模, 任务就是预测同一植物 将如何从它的一张照片,它的栽培物, 以及它的摄像头的角度, 来看待所要求天到月的地平线。 在初步分析中,即使是最先进的图像生成器也会得到这样的错误:它们常常生长的植物太少或者给它带来错生长阶段的颜色和形式. 我们提出,它们不能解决 植物的发育状态, 照片只间接揭示。 因此,我们建议农妇运动,在它取得增长之前,应该提出发展的理由。 其推理模块"PhenoClock"研究出了目前的生长阶段,预测了未来的阶段,并写了"生长脚本",其中包含高,植物面积,颜色的数值目标;其生成模块"根化伦代尔",然后编辑照片以遵循这个脚本,给被拍摄的植物添加了新的器官和颜色. 因为像素分数可以更喜欢照片的不变拷贝,我们转而对照工厂自己后来的照片来检查每个预测的特征和发展时间. 在大米方面,54.6%的AgroWM预测与目标阶段(Stage R@1)相匹配,而GPT图像为34.8%,Quen图像为24.0%,而最强域特定基线为47.4%,同一主干线经过微调后没有增长脚本;9至20周前,它仍然达到46.4%,而基准为35.7%。 在玉米上,一种有不同身体计划和舞台尺度的作物,同样的设计在所有四个尺度上都得分最高。

articles.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
articles.content: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理Robo批评 : 了解边境代理人在直接机器人控制方面的能力
articles.content_zh: GPT-6 Astra等前沿多模式语言代理已经表现出强大的能力,可以直接通过没有高层次原始物的低层次数字动作控制机器人. 然而,现有基准只报告各集的成功率,这些成功率既没有显示这些代理人如何成功,也没有显示他们在哪里失败。 在本文中,我们提出了对边界人员在12个操纵基准上进行直接机器人控制的系统行动分析。 我们介绍RoboCritic探员,这是一个基于意图的批评框架,在这个框架里,政策代理人在每项行动的同时陈述了当地的意图,一名批评者根据这一意图评价行动的结果和失败模式。 我们的行动层面分析表明,前沿人员在直接机器人控制方面有希望的能力,包括从局部执行失败中进行闭路回收,在各种场景中进行可靠的语义定位,在没有针对特定任务的调整的情况下进行强烈的零射操纵。 报告也查明了目前存在的局限性,包括与任务有关的实际执行瓶颈,例如把握和调整,以及不同失败模式的复苏不平衡。 最后,我们用400个行动人类附加基准验证我们的批评家,并发布12,844个附加说明动作的数据集,同时发布微调开放源码评论家Muse-Glimer-30B,其故障模式精度从32.58%上升到74.24%,从而能够进行低成本的行动层面分析.

articles.title: Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
articles.content: Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models' own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. For judgments of whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average ($Δd' = -0.34$ across model families; -0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: Base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning, model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. Our corpora cannot be shared, so we add a case reproducible from public data, the truth of negated statements. Here, post-training acted in the opposite direction: Probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement; below it, the representation of the statement contributed, strongly in one of four models. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved the answers on our newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on the chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代表但读错了: 培训后改变语言模型如何解读其代表的内容
articles.content_zh: 培训后是否改变语文模式代表什么,或如何将这种表述理解为答案? 我们比较了线性探测器 和模型本身的答案, 用信号检测理论分析, 在6个开放量级基模型 及其训练后的版本。 对于判断德文文本是由人类还是由AI编写,探针和n-gm分类词将各类区分得很好,但答案没有而且常常是反向命令文本. 培训后平均降低了答案的敏感性(模范家庭的“Δd'=-0.34美元;3个提示的0.29)。 它还改变了说明的基准率的使用: 基础模型转换了它们的对数,比之前的概率变化小,大多数经过培训后模型变化更多。 在设有阶段性检查站的两个模式中,变化发生在监督的微调期间,模型缝合影响到了早期的层次,并且从中深入到文本之后的各国内部位置,而不是文本中的位置,转移了检查站之间的变化。 我们的公司不能共享,所以我们增加一个可以从公共数据中复制的案件,即否定声明的真相. 在这方面,培训后的行动方向相反: 探测器在每个模型中解码出或接近天花板的真相,数个基模型的答案没有使用,训练后修复;通过中深度的修复,在陈述后停留在位置上;下面是陈述的表述,在四个模型中的一个中有很大的贡献. 在一项培训研究中,在原本相同的微调数据中,加上2000个正确标注的作者对新闻文本的判断,改进了我们报纸和教科书Corpora的答案,并在聊天中倒置了答案,他们在谈话中遵循了经过新闻训练的对基模型的探针. 因此,后培训改变了判断如何从模型中表达出来,一个小型的培训信号可以确定其方向。

articles.title: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
articles.content: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用英语和马拉地语搜索政府计划混合检索
articles.content_zh: 获取政府计划需要将公民的信息需求与正式的行政描述相匹配,这往往跨越语言和术语。 我们提出了马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划和公共服务的双语搜索系统,该系统将BM25检索与判决的相似性结合起来,通过同等重量的积分组合。 系统索引调整了英文-马拉地语方案说明,并支持多语种、马拉地语和翻译辅助语义配置。 对人工整理的双语查询的评价比较了BM25,密集检索,以及使用IndicSBERT和MahaSBERT的混合检索. BM25提供了强有力的基线,平均对等等级为0.864。 混合检索将MRR与IndicSBERT一起增加至0.872,与MahaSBERT一起增加0.879,而相应的密度唯一系统则达到0.663和0.655. 基于MahaSBERT的聚变还使精度从0.781提高到0.808,同时匹配BM25回溯0.946. 这些结果支持在本集中互补使用词典和语义信号,同时表明相对于强词典基线的改进是适度的,并取决于计量的. 该研究对双语公共服务信息获取的混合检索进行了以应用为重点的分析。

articles.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
articles.content: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.

articles.title_zh: AutoMaster:通过使同一模式成为更好的教师进行自主的后期培训
articles.content_zh: 单是任务成功并不能说明培训后应加强哪些行为。 即使是成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无根据的假设,非生产性重复,或表面的验证. 我们提出Skill-FT(Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning),使用自然语言技能压制不良习惯,并在教师推出时引起代表性不足的有效行为,然后对由此产生的轨迹目标模型进行微调. 我们引入了AutoMaster系统,这是一个自主的培训后系统,一个LLM代理人通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及推出和目标模型评估的反馈来制定这些干预措施。 AutoMaster通过终端、搜索和软件工程任务以及4B和9B目标模型,在成功无制导的教师轨迹上比Vanilla SFT改进了平均性能,提高了1.42-8.99个百分点,教师、任务池、培训套装大小和SFT配方保持不变。 这些结果与模拟和轨迹分析一起,表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师. 我们进一步发现,在SFT期间保留技能指示比在所有6个场合取消这些指示产生更高的平均性能,尽管这些指示没有参加评价,而且监督产出相同。 这些调查结果表明,作为培训示范的一部分,保持技能环境可以支持更好的行为内在化。

articles.title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
articles.content:
Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbf{GLiDE}, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters.
  Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens.
  Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance--parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI{}, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo{} (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0\% and a median latency of 92.9\,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1\%.

articles.title_zh: GLIDE: 快速、校准的决定模式
articles.content_zh:
决策模式通过在一次前传中给候选人的答案打分,而无需产生文字或中间推理,就能够迅速作出具有信心的决定。 然而,推理可以大大改善决策质量,从而引起这样一个问题,即是否能够保留其好处而不产生这种好处。 我们用\textbf{GLiDE}来调查这个问题,这是一个包括0.4B到27B参数的决策模式的家族。
在Quen混合语言模型的基础上,GLiDE通过从全心全意层中去除因果掩码,实现了上下文,问题和候选答案之间的双向交互. 为了将推理能力转移到单传推论中,我们把来自多个教师的软目标提炼(包括推理模型)与关于多种决策任务的渐进式后培训结合起来. 我们进一步探索无参数的重复深度,以增加推论时间的计算,而不产生符号.
GLiDE位于Hugging Face\DI{}的性能参数Pareto前沿, \dm2{}(27B) 实现隐藏设定的71.52分,预期校准误差2.0\%,中位间隔92.9\,ms在单张GPU上. 进一步的检查点平均和无参数的重复深度为GLiDE~27B,达到73.37,预计校准误差为2.1++.

articles.title: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
articles.content: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.

articles.title_zh: 胸X射线中的多模式错误检测 报告:大语言模型读取图像证据
articles.content_zh: Rad-Linter对照图像生成的证据检查胸部X光报告,以标出潜在的错误供审查。 一个预先训练的图像分类器为9种病理提供了分数,一个1.5B参数语言模型在1,816个实例上与LORA进行了微调,检查它们与报告的一致性. 根据同样的报告和评分,我们把它与关键词和否定规则基线进行比较。 评价使用OpenI的可控报告分数配对,一致性标签来自自动报告标签和分数阈值. 每个反事实四面体交叉两个真实报告,其中两个真实的得分矢量来自其他患者,形成两个一致和两个不一致的对. 每份报告和分数矢量都发生在这两种条件下,因此,仅输入就只允许精确度达到50%。 在131个四边形上,拉德-林特在规则基线上实现了98.5%的对准精度,而80.5%的对准精度,并将所有4对对在94.4%的四边形对56.5%中正确分类. 核对器对遗漏项目,包括未提及和否定的调查结果进行类似的检查;其余项目类型出现较大差异,需要解释如何描述调查结果。 没有微调的同一语言模型仍然接近50%的准确度. 在第二组181个象限中,包括自动标签人不同意的报告,对数准确率为93.4%,而75.3%。 这些可控的结果表明,鉴于图像生成的分数相同,经过训练的语言模型比测试的规则基线更准确地检测到报告的分数不一致,其优点集中在如何解释结果的词法上.

articles.title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
articles.content: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

articles.title_zh: MemFolder:用于高效代理内存管理的结构引导内存折叠
articles.content_zh: 长期剂随着相互作用的展开而积累了大型的外部记忆存储,增加了存储,检索和响应生成的成本. 效率受到两个因素的制约:记录数的增加增加了检索费,而检索时间较长增加了预填计算和解码时间注意费用。 现有方法对记录进行prune或合并,但进行搜索可能会丢弃有用的证据,而合并则可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。 我们引入了MemFolder,一个结构制导的内存折叠框架,它相继降低了记录的计数和上下文长度. 该框架由两个核心部分组成,共享记忆组,使用跨记录结构指导证据合并和紧凑表述。 RecordFolder ground 实体提及,逐步选择具有代表性但互为补充的锚,并将语义和实体亲和性与时间链结合,将兼容的记录整合为更少的检索单元. 上下文Folder将这些组中的原始记录编码为紧凑文本,并在关键事实无法找到时使用校验反馈来修改编码. 关于基于文本的三个内存基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多式联运基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot的实验,显示了我们方法的有力性能。 值得注意的是,在Mem0上,RecordFolder保留了三个基于文本的基准的最初平均业绩的99.0%,减少了50%的记录,在保留业绩方面超过了最强的基准1.9个百分点。 结合ContextFolder,现有的记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录,同时保留大部分性能.

articles.title: Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
articles.content: EU-funded projects produce extensive evidence in the form of deliverables, reports, and case studies. However, this knowledge is typically scattered across projects and document structures, making it difficult to locate relevant, contextual information when making decisions. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Ecosystem that consolidates heterogeneous project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and provides adaptive access through an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline. Documents from three EU-funded projects (IMPETUS, NATALIE, and InnWater) are reconstructed into hierarchical section trees and indexed with structured metadata. Retrieval is supported by two domain-specific embedding models fine-tuned on domain data (water and climate). On top of this knowledge base, a ReAct-style controller iteratively orchestrates retrieval actions by allocating retrieval budget across domain collections and accumulating evidence until a stopping criterion is met. In a retrieval benchmark over the corpus, the proposed approach improves Mean Reciprocal Rank by 26.7% (relative) compared to a single-domain embedding baseline, indicating more consistent retrieval of relevant evidence to support cross-project knowledge synthesis and climate-resilient decision-making.

articles.title_zh: 实现改变水治理和气候复原力的跨项目知识民主化:一个代理AI生态系统
articles.content_zh: 欧盟资助的项目以交付品、报告和个案研究等形式产生大量证据。 然而,这种知识通常分散在项目和文件结构中,因此在作出决定时很难找到相关和背景的信息。 本文引入了一个代理AI生态系统,将各种项目文件整合到一个有域意识的知识库中,并通过代理检索-增强生成管道提供适应性访问。 来自欧盟资助的三个项目(IMPETUS、NATALIE和InnWater)的文件被重建成分层树,并以结构化元数据索引。 检索得到两个针对特定域的嵌入模型的支持,这些模型对域数据(水和气候)进行了微调. 在这个知识库之外,一个ReAct式控制器迭代地协调检索行动,在域集中分配检索预算并积累证据,直至达到停止标准。 与单一领域嵌入基准相比,拟议方法在对本项的检索基准中将平均对等排名提高26.7%(相对),表明更一致地检索相关证据,以支持跨项目知识综合和具有气候抗御力的决策。

articles.title: HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
articles.content: Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HISA: 扩展 LLMS 中 RoPE 关注的隐藏维度
articles.content_zh: 在大语言模型(LLMs)中,注意对每一个有完整点产品键的查询进行评分. 我们调查这一点产品是否必须完全计算才能引起人们的注意。 我们提议隐蔽的 Sparse 注意(HISA),它保持查询和关键投影的完整,但只计算一个部分点产品,遵循符号位置设定的静态无参数规则: 隐藏的(地貌)维度的注意力变得稀少,这个轴比象征性的螺旋性要少得多,而不是像几乎所有稀疏的注意方法那样超过标记。 基于旋转位置嵌入(ROPE)的结构,我们把密钥和查询分解成在计算注意力时可以省略的部分. 通过从零开始与HISA一起训练LLMS,我们发现这个部分点产品并不伤害,而是比完整的产品提高了性能,同时计算出大约三分之一的查询键产品. 在推论期间,HISA改进了解码速度,缩小了记忆足迹. 我们还将HISA扩展至FlashAttention-3内核用于培训和推论. 最后,我们通过表明密集的注意力学会抑制HISA所减少的注意力部分来激励我们的方法。 代码见https://github.com/ambroise-b/hisa。

articles.title: Beam Model Technical Report
articles.content: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

articles.title_zh: Beam 模型技术报告
articles.content_zh: Beam是一种稀疏的Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)模型,总参数为501.3B,活性参数为23.4B,专门为编码,推理,代理工作量而构建和优化. 比姆提供前沿级推理,同时要求3-4x的推论计算比其类中的许多模型要少. 预训于23.8T多样化,曲折,优质的代币,Beam的特点是通过新颖的两阶段中训阶段实现的1M-token上下文窗口,基于可核查的,正确的-焦虑的数据. 培训后利用了10.5K GB300GPU的大规模、完全同步的强化学习运动,在4周的培训中产生了超过100M的推广。 我们认为这是迄今为止任何开放的实验室进行的最大规模RL运行之一. 在整个评价套件中,随着我们增加RL计算,能力继续提高,没有高原的迹象。 在深层硬件模型共设计,FP8/NVFP4量化,以及1.93B参数的投机解码起草器(DFlash 2)的支持下,Beam以高效,灵活的部署,最大限度地服务吞吐量. 平均而言,在88.9%的有害请求上,Beam在遵守81.5%的无害请求时拒绝或吐出,在帕雷托边境的开放型模型中,有害请求的拒绝/中枢率最高。

articles.title: One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination
articles.content: Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale. Alikbachan is a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along three crossed axes: a human-validated cultural-distance band, six task types, and a five-family, 32-mode hallucination taxonomy. It comprises a harvested 2,516-item test set (Phase 1) and a quota-constructed, gold-labeled 5,000-item set (Phase 2). The stratification is diagnostic. Four zero-shot LLM judges vary by over 30 macro-F1 points across strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile: discourse-level omission defeats judges and most teams alike, whereas only a minority over-flag negative controls. The judges' verdict probabilities rank items well (ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95) but are overconfident (ECE 0.04-0.29). An open competition on Alikbachan drew 222 teams and 3,566 submissions, and a single-prompt 32B judge reaches the 57th percentile. Of the 25 teams in both phases, 24 regress on Phase 2 (mean $-17.6$ points) while every zero-shot judge improves, and Phase-1 rank barely predicts Phase-2 rank (Spearman $ρ=0.35$), so a Phase-1 leaderboard alone would have crowned a different winner.
