articles.title_zh: 一个诊断所有问题的框架:孟加拉LLM的分级基准 幻觉
articles.content_zh: 低资源语言的幻觉研究很容易地碎片化:每个新命名的失败模式都会提示自己的数据集,在不可比较的资源上花费稀缺的注释器. 我们主张整合,并在社区范围内测试。 Alikbachan是一个孟加拉幻觉探测基准,沿着三个交叉轴线进行分级:一个人类验证的文化-距离波段,六个任务类型,以及一个五家三十二模式幻觉分类学. 它包括一套收获的2 516项试验(第1阶段)和一套配额制的、有金标签的5 000项试验(第2阶段)。 分层是诊断。 4个零镜头LLM评委各阶层的宏观-F1分不同,99个Phase-1和32个Phase-2比赛系统的项目级预测转载了该简介:话语级省略使评委和大多数球队都落败,而只有少数的超标负控. 法官的判决概率对项目排名良好(ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95),但过于自信(ECE 0.04-0.29)。 阿利克巴昌的公开比赛吸引了222支球队和3,566人提交,一名单速32B裁判达到了57%. 在两个阶段的25支球队中,有24支在第二阶段(平均17.6美元积分)出现倒退,而每名零射门裁判则会提高,第一期的排名几乎无法预测第一期的排名(Spearman $ρ=0.35美元),因此单靠一个第一期的领跑板就能获得不同的冠军.

articles.title: Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling for Target Language Extraction
articles.content: Target Language Extraction (TLE) aims to isolate speech in a target language from multilingual mixtures. Existing approaches primarily rely on acoustic modeling with language identity labels, which provide only coarse categorical guidance. In this work, we propose a language-oriented semantic modeling framework that augments acoustic extraction with language-specific semantic representations. A pre-trained speech semantic model is adapted via language-aware prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning to generate target-language-focused semantic representations from the mixture. {These capture high-level semantic structure of the acoustics and they} are integrated into the extraction model to provide structured semantic guidance beyond identity labels. Experiments on the CommonVoiceMix dataset show that incorporating semantic representations consistently improves over acoustic-only baselines, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR gain.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 目标语言提取语义模型
articles.content_zh: 目标语言提取(TLE)旨在将目标语言中的言语与多种语言的混合物隔离开来. 现有方法主要依靠带有语言身份标签的声学模型,这只提供了粗糙的绝对指导. 在这部作品中,我们提出了一个面向语言的语义模型化框架,用语言特有的语义表达来增强声学提取. 通过语言意识的即时调制和参数效率高的微调来调整预训语义模型,生成来自混合物的目标语言重点语义表现. {这些捕捉声学的高级语义结构和它们}被整合到提取模型中,以提供除身份标签以外的结构化语义指导. 在CommonVoiceMix数据集上的实验显示,纳入语义表达比仅声学基线持续改善,实现最高1.16 dB SI-SDR增益.

articles.title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
articles.content: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BADS-3.0: 实时驾驶感知和从一台相机进行规划
articles.content_zh: 我们问驾驶模型用一台相机和实时延迟能达到多大程度. BADS-3.0是一个1B参数的视频编码器,有四个小头. 从一个前置相机的2秒,它预测了当前的速度,刚驱动的公尺路径,碰撞风险分数和6个候选期货超过6.4秒,在50ms以下. 鉴于该车目前的速度,BADS-3.0在5个轨迹基准上比34B Alpamayo 2 Super低44%的minADE$_6美元,后者读取6台相机,运行速度较100x慢. 所得来自两个模型都没有经过训练的摄像机钻机。 在他们共享的钻机上,两者处于平价状态. 现有基准大多是名义驱动,因此我们增加了两个开放式安全基准,一个是真正的短程相机碰撞和近似失速,另一个是欧洲NCAP方案。 两者,BADS-3.0的通过率都高于我们测试的每个公布的计程员.

articles.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
articles.content: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.

articles.title_zh: 双重标准:LLM时代同行审评的主张-同源化
articles.content_zh: 同行评审依赖于一些读者发现不同的问题. 我们衡量会议和期刊审查中的批评重叠情况。 在ICLR中,经测量的重叠率从2026年的12.0%上升到2027年的21.3%,从审查过程的同一阶段来看,NeurIPS,ICML以及F1000和PLOS期刊的逐年上升. ICLR对一篇论文的第三次审查在2027年将5.46个新问题加进了另外两个,而2026年则增加了6.12个. 我们对所有审查采用LLM生成文本的探测器MELD。 在一篇论文中,有两篇评论认为MELD旗与两篇以上的无旗评论重叠:2024-2025年ICLR的3.0分,2026-2027年的4.5分,5个期刊来源的5.4分. 这些结果表明,对一份文件的LLM标记式审查与未标记式审查相比,彼此区别不大,表明对单一文件的审查中批评的多样性正在下降。

articles.title: What If Chain-of-Thought Is Not Enough?
articles.content: Reasoning capabilities in large language models have evolved from prompting-based methods to internalized model behaviors. In this paper, we investigate whether the internal thinking model of an LLM can be deliberately changed and whether such a change is beneficial. Instead of relying on Chain-of-Thought, we train models to follow Question--Option--Criteria (QOC), a structured decision process that decomposes a task into explicit questions, competing options, and evaluation criteria. We present a three-generation development pipeline that ranges from a basic QOC decision core to richer answer synthesis and statistically enriched QOC reasoning. We then evaluate the resulting models with respect to both internal consistency and output quality. Across the reported experiments, QOC-based fine-tuning improves answer quality relative to non-fine-tuned base models and yields particularly strong gains once models are large enough to execute the underlying QOC computations reliably. The results suggest that the internal thinking model of an LLM is trainable and that structured alternatives to Chain-of-Thought can provide a promising path toward more reliable, interpretable, and task-adapted decision support.

articles.title_zh: 如果思考链还不够呢?
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型中的理性能力已经从基于激励的方法演变为内化模型行为. 在本文中,我们调查是否可以故意改变LLM的内部思维模式,以及这种改变是否有益。 我们不依靠 " 思考链 " ,而是培训遵循 " 问题-备选-标准 " (QOC)的模型,这是一个结构化的决策进程,将一项任务分解为明确的问题、相互竞争的选择和评价标准。 我们提出了一个三代发展管道,它从基本质量OC决定核心到更丰富的回答综合和统计上丰富的质量OC推理。 然后,我们在内部一致性和产出质量方面评价由此产生的模式。 在整个报告的实验中,基于QOC的微调比非精细调试的基础模型提高了解答质量,一旦模型足够大,足以可靠地执行基本的QOC计算,则会产生特别强的收益。 结果表明,LLM的内部思维模式是可训练的,结构化的 " 思考链 " 的替代品可以为更可靠、可解释和适合任务的决定支持提供有希望的途径。

articles.title: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
articles.content: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize confidence learning or commitment policies. However, these approaches operate on the outputs of a single denoising forward pass, in which information from the prompt, previously committed tokens, and uncommitted positions may not yet be fully integrated. Consequently, some predictions remain under-refined when the commitment decision is made, and modifying the commitment policy alone cannot improve their underlying representations. We introduce dLoop, which restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture and recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state. Rather than advancing the denoising process, each additional loop provides further latent computation, allowing information distributed across uncommitted positions to continue interacting and become more fully integrated before commitment. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, and HumanEval show that dLoop achieves the highest or tied-highest accuracy on every benchmark. With tokens per forward pass (TPF) adjusted for loop computation, it outperforms Fast-dLLM in both accuracy and TPF on all four benchmarks and dParallel on three, and is more accurate than d3LLM on all four, while d3LLM attains higher TPF; no compared method surpasses dLoop in both. Mechanistic analyses show that extra loops mainly help on slow, unstable trajectories and that updates at uncommitted positions drive changes in token decisions and later generation. Pre-commitment latent computation thus makes predictions more reliable, offering a route to DLM acceleration distinct from forcing confidence through the training loss.

articles.title_zh: dLoop:通过经常Latent改进的循环扩散语言模型
articles.content_zh: 扩散语言模型(DLMs)支持平行生成,然而它们往往需要许多去名步骤,因为只有一小部分的符号预测足够可靠,可以在每个步骤上承诺. 现有的加速方法主要是优化信心学习或承诺政策。 然而,这些办法依靠的是单一取消前期通行证的产出,在该通行证中,来自迅速、先前承诺的标志和未承诺立场的信息可能尚未充分整合。 因此,在作出承诺决定时,有些预测仍然不够完善,仅修改承诺政策并不能改善它们的基本表述。 我们引入dLoop,它将一个预先训练的传播语言模型重组为Prelude-Loop-Coda架构,并反复将一个参数共享的中间块应用到同一个部分遮掩状态. 每个额外的循环不是推进解密进程,而是提供进一步的潜伏计算,使分布在未承诺位置上的信息能够继续互动,并在承诺之前更加全面整合。 在GSM8K,MATH,MBPP,和HumanEval上的实验显示,dLoop在每个基准上都实现了最高或捆绑最高的精度. 每一次前传的令牌(TPF)经过调整以进行循环计算后,它在所有四个基准的精确度和TPF的精确度上都超过了快速dLLLM,在三个基准上都超过了dParallel,而且在所有四个基准上都比d3LLLM更准确,而d3LLLM则获得更高的TPF;在这两个基准上,没有比比方法都超过dLoop. 机械分析显示,额外的循环主要有助于缓慢、不稳定的轨迹,在非承诺位置更新会推动象征性决定和后世的改变。 因此,承诺前的潜在计算使预测更加可靠,为DLM加速提供了一条与通过培训损失而强迫信任不同的路径。

articles.title: STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
articles.content: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on Wildfire and 0.710 on Hurricane. Cross-disaster experiments reveal asymmetric transfer, highlighting sensitivity to dataset-specific spatio-temporal shifts. These results demonstrate the value of scalable cross-tweet supervision combined with relational event modeling for causal learning across fragmented disaster reports.

articles.title_zh: 步骤:微弱监管的跨潮间带事件原因的空间增强图扩展 发现
articles.content_zh: 灾害相关社交媒体中10个跨度的独立帖子的因果关系,使得交叉调频因果发现难以进行大规模监督和建模. 我们提议STAGE,一个框架,将可伸缩的跨微弱的超视觉构建与斯皮提奥-时空关系学习区分开来。 从本地因果种子开始,STAGE在微博上检索了与事件相关的事件,并使用因果计分器来构建贴有微弱标签的交叉对子. 这些对子监督一个多头图注目网络,监督内容精密丰富的事件表述和时空图。 我们用人体金色的横纹测试机和15个基线 来评估加州野火和飓风哈维的STAGE 与仅在当地进行的监管相比,建造的交叉式监管使STAGE AUPRC在野火上改善0.340,飓风上改善0.107. STAGE实现域内AUROC0.885对野火,0.710对飓风. 跨灾害实验揭示了不对称的转移,突出了对数据集特异性时空转移的敏感性. 这些结果表明,可伸缩的交叉微调监督以及关系事件模型对分散的灾害报告进行因果学习的价值。

articles.title: TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
articles.content: AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent's report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.

articles.title_zh: TwinLab-Bench:在真实实验室的代理双胞胎中评价AI科学家
articles.content_zh: 人们越来越期望AI代理作为AI的科学家,这需要三种日益开放的能力:正确执行特定计算工作流程,从特定设计空间中选择下一个测量,以及设计自己的实验. 现有基准主要通过一个终端或从预先确定的候选人中选择的闭环来评价前两个能力. 评估第三种能力需要可靠地实施一种由物剂设计的实验,其读数以真正的实验室为基础。 我们介绍TwinLab-Bench, 评估AI科学家在物理科学、生命科学和工程等实验室的52项任务中自行设计的实验。 该基准支持100多种实验动作类型,与从真实的实验室记录中提取的隐藏答案相比,剂的报告被打分. 每项任务都有自己的TwinLab剂,一种作为环境的剂,并且执行被测试的剂设计的实验,读取实验室的原材料,调用从其记录中构建的计算器. 与只看到任务描述的语言模型相比,TwinLab代理几乎消除了偏离真实记录的读数和对重复请求的不一致的回答,并且关闭本对从内存中召回答案的控制. 我们发现,对于前沿模型来说,这些任务仍然是艰巨的:最强者克劳德·费布尔5.2,平均只有45.0分,我们对其失败之处进行了实证研究.

articles.title: Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author
articles.content: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who. The latest models (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon) match trained detectors like Pangram while also explaining their predictions in natural language, and Opus 5.5 names the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Most strikingly, Fable 5.2 correctly names the author of 39% of public peer reviews published in Oct-Nov 2026 (78% on a subset of reviews from Nature), and identifies the username behind 69% of comments from active Redditors (with >500 posts over the last year). Accuracy depends on exposure to an author's writing in pretraining data and on reasoning effort, and simply asking a model how familiar it is with someone predicts whether it can identify their writing. For anyone who has published enough writing online, frontier models present a greater threat to anonymity than commonly assumed, and defenses are limited.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 边疆模型只需一个文本就可以揭开其人文或AI作者的身份
articles.content_zh: 鉴于一个单一的文本和一个简单的零镜头即时(没有网络访问,工具,候选名单,或写样本),前沿模型可以在三个越来越具体的层面上回答"是谁写的?":(1)是AI还是人类写的,(2)是AI,哪个实验室写的,(3)是人类写的,往往是确切的谁写的. 最新的模型(Claude Fable 5.2,GPT-6.1 Sol,双子座4 Carbon)匹配了Pangram等受过训练的探测器,同时也用自然语言解释它们的预测,Opus 5.5将来自Anthropic,OpenAI,Google的模型生成的98%的文本命名为正确的实验室. 最令人惊讶的是,Fable 5.2在2026年十月-十一月发布的公开同行评审中,39%的作者正确命名(78%来自自然评论的子集),并且确定69%来自活跃的Redditors的评论背后的用户名(去年有 > 500个帖子). 准确性取决于作者在预训数据中的写作和推理努力的暴露,只是问一个模型对某人的熟悉程度如何预测它是否能够识别他们的写作. 对任何在网上发表足够著作的人来说,前沿模型对匿名性的威胁比通常假设的要大,辩护也很有限.

articles.title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
articles.content: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

articles.title_zh: 通过适应性数据选择, 学会忠实地思考图像
articles.content_zh: 用图像思考(TwI)可以增强视觉语言模型(VLMs)的能力,通过积极裁剪和放大精细的视觉细节来克服知觉瓶颈,同时保证更高的准确度和可解释的,基于区域的推理. 然而,我们的分析表明,TwI模型精度的提高并不能保证忠实工具的使用;它们经常引用工具而不实际依赖放大区域,破坏了工具辅助推理的可靠性. 我们追踪这种不诚实的行为到训练数据:当问题解答而不缩放时,模型可以正确回答,同时忽略返回的证据,随着模型在没有工具的情况下更善于回答,这个问题在训练期间变得更加严重. 为了在整个培训中保持放大效果,我们根据模型不断发展的能力调整培训数据,并对正确放大的证据仍然能帮助模型正确回答的问题进行培训。 这一选择得到了数据合成管道的支持,该管道将小物体定位,并构建关于其细微细节的可核查问题,并辅以适应性奖励,在不需要缩放时有利于无工具答案. 实验结果显示,我们的方法大大提高了推理的忠诚度,实现了视觉搜索基准(V*+11.6%,HR-Bench 4K+7.9%,HR-Bench 8K+9.4%)的先进性能. 在多式联运幻觉基准方面,我们的模型也超过了比较的TwI基线。 这些结果表明,提高TwI的忠诚度不会牺牲准确性,而且两者都可以从正确的培训数据中学习,而不直接监督推理过程。

articles.title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
articles.content: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 世界模型能否预测稻米增长? 走向农业世界模式
articles.content_zh: 世界模型可以想象一个物理场景在接下来的几秒钟里是如何演变的,但是种植者需要知道一种作物会如何在几周到几个月的时间里发展:这个稻田会从现在开始开花一个月,它如何看待收成? 我们引入了农业世界建模, 任务就是预测同一植物 将如何从它的一张照片,它的栽培物, 以及它的摄像头的角度, 来看待所要求天到月的地平线。 在初步分析中,即使是最先进的图像生成器也会得到这样的错误:它们常常生长的植物太少或者给它带来错生长阶段的颜色和形式. 我们提出,它们不能解决 植物的发育状态, 照片只间接揭示。 因此,我们建议农妇运动,在它取得增长之前,应该提出发展的理由。 其推理模块"PhenoClock"研究出了目前的生长阶段,预测了未来的阶段,并写了"生长脚本",其中包含高,植物面积,颜色的数值目标;其生成模块"根化伦代尔",然后编辑照片以遵循这个脚本,给被拍摄的植物添加了新的器官和颜色. 因为像素分数可以更喜欢照片的不变拷贝,我们转而对照工厂自己后来的照片来检查每个预测的特征和发展时间. 在大米方面,54.6%的AgroWM预测与目标阶段(Stage R@1)相匹配,而GPT图像为34.8%,Quen图像为24.0%,而最强域特定基线为47.4%,同一主干线经过微调后没有增长脚本;9至20周前,它仍然达到46.4%,而基准为35.7%。 在玉米上,一种有不同身体计划和舞台尺度的作物,同样的设计在所有四个尺度上都得分最高。
